v: Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual, t'a schab'il uj yik schab'il ab'il yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, haton b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová Dios b'aj sch'ox sb'a. Ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'chaanh sb'isul heb' winak t'a skal heb' etchonhab' israel, hato syal junjun makan yaj heb' haton heb' ayto yuj sb'a, yik wach' tz'ilji jantak heb' yet' tastak sb'i heb'.
Sb'ischaj heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal, sb'eynhejb'ati, haton heb' smoj wal sb'at t'a owal, tz'ak'chajoch heb' t'a makkiltakil. Kolwajokab' winhaj Aarón het'ok,
yet' pax junjun yajalil junjun inhtilal.

Haton sb'i juntzanh heb' yajal yowalil skolwaj het'ok tik: Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Rubén, haton winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Simeón, haton winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Judá, haton winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Isacar, haton winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Zabulón, haton winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón. Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj José, ha t'a heb' yik winhaj Efraín, haton winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, ha t'a heb' yik winhaj Manasés, haton winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Benjamín, haton winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Dan, haton winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Aser, haton winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gad, haton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Neftalí, haton winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, xchi Dios.
Haton juntzanh heb' yajal tik ix sik'chajel t'a skal masanil yinhtilal Israel.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual t'a schab'il ujal yik jun ab'il chi', ix smolb'ej juntzanh heb' winh tik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, to satil tz'ajkan heb' winh yuj Dios. Hanheja' ix molb'ajpax masanil heb' chonhab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' israel. T'a stzolal ix aj stz'ib'chaj sb'i heb', haton heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal, sb'eynhejb'ati, hato ha' smakanhil t'a junjun inhtilal,
icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Ha t'a tzinan lu'um t'a Sinaí ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' chi'.

Ha t'a junjun inhtilal, t'a junjun makkiltakil, ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' chi'. Ix tz'ib'chaj sb'i heb' yet' sb'isul heb' winak tz'akanxo yab'ilal t'a 20 ab'il, yuj chi' haton wal ix aj yelk'och tik: Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Rubén, haton sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel, 46 mil 500 heb' winak smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Simeón, ay 59 mil 300.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Gad, ay 45 mil 650.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Judá, ay 74 mil 600.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Isacar, ay 54 mil 400.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Zabulón, ay 57 mil 400.
Haxo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj José: Ay 40 mil 500 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Efraín, ay pax 32 mil 200 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Manasés.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Benjamín, ay 35 mil 400.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Dan, ay 62 mil 700.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aser, ay 41 mil 500.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Neftalí, ay 53 mil 400.
Haton ix aj yelk'och juntzanh sb'isul ix yik'chaanh winhaj Moisés tik, winhaj Aarón yet' lajchawanhxo heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel t'a junjun inhtilal.
Ix k'e waan juntzanh sb'isul chi' t'a junjun inhtilal, t'a junjun makkiltakil. Ha heb' israel, 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, haton heb' chi' smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a smasanil ay 603 mil 550 heb'.
Ha yinhtilal winhaj Leví, maj ak'jiochlaj heb' sb'isulok,
yujto a Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Moisés:
Ayik ol ik'ank'e waan sb'isul chonhab' Israel tik, manh ol ak'ochlaj yinhtilal winhaj Leví sb'isulok.

Yujto a ex yinhtilalexkan winhaj Leví chi', ol ex och yak'umalok serwil in kajnub' b'aj ayek' skaxail in trato yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Hanheja' ex ol eyik'nhej b'ey in kajnub' chi' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Yowalil ol ex ajnhej kajan t'a spatik yichanh in kajnub' chi'.
Ayik tz'ik'jib'at t'a juntak el, a ex tze xuyemi, tze b'oanpaxk'e b'aj sk'och chi'. Yalnhej mach junok anima manh lewitaok sjawi t'a slak'anil jun in kajnub' chi', tojolnhej schami.
Haxo masanil juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel ol kajnaj icha t'a stzolal, junjun heb' ol aj t'a skampamento, t'a yalanh sbandera.
Ha exxo pax yinhtilal ex kan winhaj Leví chi' jun, ha t'a spatik yichanh in kajnub' ol ex ajok. Ha ex ol he tanhwej, yik wach' max kot wowal t'a in chonhab' Israel, xchi Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel sk'ulan icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:

Ayik sb'oank'e skampamento heb' israel t'a junok lugar, junjun tz'aj t'a yalanh sbandera yet' junjun makkiltakil, yowalil najattak wal tz'ajel heb' t'a spatik yichanh mantiado, haton b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, hata' tz'aj skampamento oxe' inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Judá. Ha heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Judá chi', a winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 74 mil 600 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj skampamento yinhtilal Isacar yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 54 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Zabulón. Ha winhaj Eliab, yuninal winhaj Helón ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 57 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 186 mil 400 heb' soldado, haton heb' b'ab'el sb'at t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' israel.
Haxo t'a stojolal sur, hata' tz'aj skampamento oxe' inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Rubén. Ha heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Rubén chi', a winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 46 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj skampamento yinhtilal Simeón yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 59 mil 300 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Gad yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Reuel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 45 mil 650 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Rubén chi', ay 151 mil 450 heb' soldado, haton heb' sb'ey t'a yik schab'il makan.

Sb'atpax heb' lewita t'a skal chanhe' kampamento. Ha heb' et'jinak smantiadoal b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Ha chanhe' kampamento chi', t'a stzolal tz'aj sb'eyi icha tas yajek' heb' t'a skampamento, junjun heb' t'a yalanhtak sbandera.

Haxo t'a stojolal b'aj sb'at k'u, hata' tz'aj skampamento oxe' inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Efraín. Ha heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Efraín chi', a winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 40 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj yinhtilal Manasés yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 32 mil 200 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Benjamín. Ha winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 35 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Efraín chi', ay 108 mil 100 soldado, haton heb' sb'ey t'a yoxil makan.
Haxo t'a stojolal norte, hata' tz'aj skampamento oxexo inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Dan. Ha heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Dan chi', a winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 62 mil 700 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj skampamento yinhtilal Aser yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 41 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Neftalí yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 53 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Dan chi', ay 157 mil 600 heb' soldado. Haton heb' sb'eyb'at t'a spatik sbandera yinhtilal Dan chi', haton heb' tzak'anto sb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha sb'isul heb' israel, ay 603 mil 550 heb' soldado t'a smasanil.
Palta maj och heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví sb'isulok, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'ulej heb' israel icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Junnhej ix aj heb' t'a yalanhtak sbandera, ix b'eyb'at heb' t'a stzolal, hato syal junjun makkiltakil.
Haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Moisés tik, ayik ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi': Winhaj Nadab b'ab'el winak, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Ha heb' chanhwanh tik, ix sik'jiel heb', ix ochkan yopisio heb' sakerdoteal.

Palta a winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, yujto ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh icha ofrenda t'a yichanh Jehová to manh smojok. Mantalaj yuninal heb' ta', yuj chi' haxonhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix munlaj sakerdoteal t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Aarón haton smam heb'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Awtej masanil heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Leví, yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj sakerdote Aarón icha ol yal winh.

Ha heb' chi' ayoch yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a yichanh chonhab' t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Stanhwanpax masanil yamk'ab' yik mantiado chi' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji serwil masanil chonhab' Israel yuj heb' t'a masanil munlajel b'aj ay in kajnub'.
Ik'chajokab'el heb' lewita t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab' smasanil yik wach' syak' serwil winhaj Aarón heb' yet' t'a masanil yinhtilal winh.
Anhej t'a yib'anh winh yet' yinhtilal tz'ochkan yopisio yak'an sakerdoteal. Tato ay junok mach manh yinhtilok winh chi' syekoch sb'a t'a jun opisio chi', yowalil schami, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Toxo ix ex in sik'kanel a ex lewita ex tik sk'exulok junjun heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik eyaji.

Ayik ix wak'ancham masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a Egipto, ix wak'kan sb'ab'el winak unin heb' etisraelal yik tz'ochkan wikok, icha pax chi' nok' b'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' wik yaji. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lu'um Sinaí, ix yalani:
Ik'k'e waan sb'isul heb' etlewitail, icha junjun makkiltakil, masanil heb' winak t'a he kal. Tza chael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yik'chaanh sb'isul heb' winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Koat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Koat: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal. Ha heb' winh tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, cha makan yaj heb', haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Libni yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Simei.
Ha sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ix chajiel yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 7 mil 500.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová tz'aj skampamento heb'.
Ha pax mach yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, haton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Lael.
Haton heb' tz'ilan juntzanh smakul yib'anh skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' k'apak kortina ayoch t'a sti' skajnub' chi',
k'apak skortinail amak' oyanoch t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová yet' b'aj ay altar, k'apak kortina ayoch t'a sti' amak' chi' yet' sch'anhal ayoch t'a spatik syamk'ab'il.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat, chanh makan yaj heb': Haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Amram, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Izhar, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Hebrón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Uziel.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak ix schael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 8 mil 600 heb', haton heb' tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal sur tz'aj skampamento heb'.
Ha yajalil juntzanh heb', haton winhaj Elizafán yuninal winhaj Uziel.
Haton heb' tik tz'ilan te' skaxail trato, te' mexa, sb'akhnub' kandil, chab' altar yet' masanil jantak syamk'ab'il sk'anchaj t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yet' pax k'apak kortina ayoch t'a yool.
Ha jun sat yajal yajoch t'a skal heb' lewita chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan masanil heb' smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, cha makan yaj heb', haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Mahli yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Musi.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 6 mil 200 heb'.
Ha yajalil heb', haton winhaj Zuriel yuninal winhaj Abihail. Tz'aj skampamento heb' t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal norte.
Haton heb' tik tz'ilan te' smarkoal, sreglail, yoyal, sb'akhnub'al, masanil syamk'ab'il,
yet' pax yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak amak', sb'akhnub'al, yestakail yet' masanil sch'anhal.

Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at skajnub' Jehová tz'aj skampamento winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', haton heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a yol skajnub' Jehová chi' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel. Tato ay junok mach sk'och t'a slak'anil kajnub' chi' to manh yopisiook yaji, tojolnhej schami.

Ayik ix yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' lewita winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a stzolal icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ay 22 mil, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ik'chaanh sb'isul yet' sb'i heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etchonhab', tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.

Ha heb' lewita tik, wik yaj heb' sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi'. Hanheja' wikpax tz'ajkan masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' sk'exulok nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' israel tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel yuj winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Masanil heb' winak unin jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 22 mil 273 heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ak'kanoch heb' lewita tik sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel. Hanheja' pax nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' tz'ochkan sk'exulok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yetisraelal, yujto wik yaj heb' lewita tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

Palta ek'al sb'isul heb' b'ab'el unin t'a chonhab' Israel t'a yichanh heb' lewita chi', yuj chi' ha t'a junjun heb' 273 b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', tza k'an oyeok siklo k'een plata, icha jantak yalil k'een sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', haton 20 geras yalil.
Tzak'an juntzanh k'een tumin chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, haton tz'och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj smolank'e k'een tumin winhaj Moisés ix och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel syak' sobre chi'.
Ix molchaj mil 365 siklo k'een plata, icha jantak yalil k'een sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'een winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'k'e waan sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat t'a stzolal t'a skal heb' lewita,
haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50. Haton heb' tik smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ha smunlajel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat chi', to a juntzanh tastak wiknhej yaji, a stanhwej heb', haton juntzanh tik:
Ayik sb'atxi heb' chonhab', a ach ach Aarón yet' heb' uninal, tzeyik'el k'apak kortina ayoch smakulok jun Lugar Wiknhej Yaji, tze musan te' skaxail in trato t'a k'apak.
Haxo t'a yib'anh tzeyak'b'at jun tz'uum te lab'ab'i smusilok. Haxo t'a yib'anh jun chi' tzeyak'b'at jun k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak, tzeyak'anoch te' b'akhlab' yik tz'ik'jib'ati.

Tzeyak'anpaxb'at jun k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak t'a sat mexa ay t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh jun chi' tzeyak'em k'een plato, juntzanh k'een niwak kuchara, uk'ab' yet' juntzanh xalual wino tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail yet' ixim pan tz'ak'jitaxoni.
Ha t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chi' tzeyak'b'at jun chakchak k'apak, tze musan t'a jun tz'uum te lab'ab'i chi', tzeyak'anpaxoch te' b'akhlab' yik tz'ik'jib'ati.

Tzeyik'anpaxkot junxo k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak, tze musan jun sb'akhnub' kandil yet' juntzanh kandil chi', k'een k'een tz'ik'anel staanhil k'apak k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al kandil yet' platillo yet' masanil yet'tal sk'anchaj yet' akeite.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tze musej t'a jun nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i, tzeyak'ank'e t'a yib'anh te b'akhlab'.
Tzeyak'anpaxb'at junxo k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak t'a yib'anh altar nab'a oro. Tze pichan t'a juntzanh nok' tz'uum lab'ab'i, tzeyak'anpaxoch ste'al yik sb'akhchaji.

Tze molanpax k'e waan masanil yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a yol in kajnub', tze pichanoch t'a yol jun k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak, tzeyak'anoch juntzanhxo nok' tz'uum lab'ab'i t'ay, tzeyak'ank'e t'a yib'anh te b'akhlab'.
Yowalil tzeyik'el jantak k'een taanh kalan yet' xepu' stz'a t'a altar, slajwi chi' tze musan altar chi' t'a jun k'apak k'apak yaxmakinak.

Haxo t'a yib'anh tz'ak'jib'at masanil tastak sk'anchaj t'a altar chi': Haton yet'tal tzak'ak' yet' juntzanh k'een tenedor, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab' yet' juntzanhxo yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il. Ha t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ak'jib'at nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i, tzeyak'anpaxoch te te' yik sb'akhchaji.

Ayik slajwi he pichan masanil juntzanh tastak niwan yelk'och chi', wach'xo yaji yik tz'ik'jib'ati, skot heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat yik syik'anb'at heb'. Masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaj chi', max yal-laj syaman heb' yik max cham heb' yuj. Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il yik in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat yowalil tz'ik'anb'ati.

Ha winhaj Eleazar, winh uninal a ach sakerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan tas yaj akeite yik kandil, inkienso wach' sjab', ofrenda yik ixim trigo to yowalil tz'ak'ji t'ayin yet' akeite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan wikok. Ha winh stanhwan in kajnub' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
Mokab' satel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat t'a skal heb' eyetlewitail.

Yik max jawi chamel t'a yib'anh heb', yuj syaman heb' tastak to wiknhej yaji, yowalil tze b'eyb'alej juntzanh tik: Ach Aarón yet' heb' uninal, yowalil tzex och yet' heb' t'a yol in kajnub'. Ha ex tzeyal t'a heb' tastak syik'b'at junjun heb'.
Yuj chi', max och heb' junok rato yil tastak to wik yaji, yik max cham heb' yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal,
haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50, haton heb' smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Haton smunlajel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón tik t'a mantiado chi':
Ha heb' yowalil tz'ik'anb'at k'apak smakul yib'anh in kajnub' yet' chab'xo jenhan smakul yib'anh, nok' tz'um lab'ab'i ayoch smakulok yib'anh, k'apak kortina ayoch t'a smakulok sti',

k'apak kortina ayoch t'a spatiktak yamaq'uil in kajnub' b'aj ay altar, k'apak kortina ayoch b'aj ay sti' yamaq'uil chi' yet' syamk'ab'il yet' jantak sch'anhal ayochi yik tz'och t'a yopisio. Ha heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan juntzanh ix b'inaj tik.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, a heb' skuchb'an masanil heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón chi' t'a munlajel sk'ulej yet' yik'anb'at tastak heb' to tz'ik'jib'ati. Ha heb' tik sch'oxan tastak syik'b'at junjun heb'.

Haton wal yopisio heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón tik ayik smunlaj heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Sk'anab'ajejokab' masanil tas syal winhaj Itamar heb', haton winh yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón.
Ik'chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari t'a stzolal,
haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50, haton heb' smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ha smunlajel heb', haton yik'anb'at masanil ste'al mantiado chi' heb', haton smarkoal, sreglail, yoyal yet' sb'akhnub'al,
masanil yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak yamaq'uil in kajnub', sb'akhnub'al yich, yestakail, sch'anhal yet' masanil syamk'ab'il sk'anchaji. Ha ex tzeyala' tastak yowalil syik'b'at junjun heb'.
Ha jun munlajel tik skan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari. Ha winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón, a winh tz'alani tas sk'ulej heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', a heb' ix ik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' lewita smoj wal smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50. Haton heb' tik: Eb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Merari. T'a stzolal ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat, icha stzolal, ay 2 mil 750 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, icha stzolal, ay 2 mil 630 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, icha stzolal, ay 3 mil 200 heb' t'a smasanil. Haxo sb'isul heb' lewita chi' ix yik'chanh winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yajal yaji, icha syal stzolal, haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50 to smoj wal smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, ay 8 mil 580 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ha jun sb'isul tik, ix ik'chajk'e waan, ix alchaj t'a junjun heb' tastak sk'ulej yet' tastak syik'b'ati, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a masanil heb' etisraelal to a heb' anima penaay yuj lepra, heb' tz'el yinhatil yuj junok ilya ayoch t'ay, ma heb' syaman junok chamnak, yowalil tz'ik'jiel heb' t'a spatikel kampamento.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', tz'ik'jiel heb', heb' winh winak ma heb' ix ix, yik malaj tas manh wach'ok t'a yol kampamento b'aj ayinek' heyet'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel yik'anelta juntzanh heb' anima chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak, ma junok ix ix max in k'anab'ajani, syixtan yetanimail, wan yoch smul.
Yowalil syojtakejel spaltail chi'. Hanhejtona', yowalil syak'xi sk'exul tastak ix yixtejb'at chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh stojol juntzanh chi'.

Tato toxo ix cham jun mach ix ixtajb'at tastak ay t'ay chi', manhxa pax junok ayto yuj sb'a smoj schaan sk'exul junok tas chi', a jun chi', tz'ochkan wikok, haxo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sakerdote skani. Hanhejtona' syak'anpax junok nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix och chi'.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' etisraelal t'ayin, tz'ik'jib'at t'a heb' sakerdote. Ha juntzanh chi', yik heb' sakerdote chi' yaji.
Masanil tastak syak' junok etisraelal t'ayin, tato tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sakerdote, yik winh tz'ajkani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés
to syal juntzanh tik winh t'a heb' yetisraelal: Talaj ay junok winak sna t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum to ay smul ix say t'a yol sk'ab',

to smulan ix yet' junok winak, palta max nachajel-laj yuj winh tato toxo ix mulan ix, yujto max yal ix, malaj pax junok mach ix ilan smulan ix. Mato ay pax junok winak tonhej snaank'e icha chi' t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum chi', wach'chom malaj smul ix syak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

Ha t'a cha makan lolonel icha chi', a winh winak chi', syal yik'anb'at ix yetb'eyum winh t'a yichanh junok winh sakerdote. Syak'an chanheok libra ixim harina kebada winh ofrendail yuj ix, palta max sekjiemlaj akeite t'a yib'anh ixim, max ak'jipaxlaj inkienso yet' ixim, yujto a jun ofrenda chi', ofrenda yik k'ak'alk'olal, yopisio yik scheklajelta mul.
Haxo winh sakerdote chi' tz'alani to snitzkot sb'a ix ix chi', tz'ik'jioch ix t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.

Elanhchamel syik'kot jab'ok ha ha' winh sakerdote chi' t'a yol junok lum uk'ab', haton ha ha' wiknhej yaji. Syik'anpaxk'e jab'ok pokok winh, haton lum ay t'a in kajnub', syak'anb'at winh t'a skal ha ha' chi'.

Tz'och linhan ix ix chi' yuj winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, syik'anel sk'ox ix, tz'ak'jipaxoch jun ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Haxo winh sakerdote chi' et'jinakk'e ha ha' k'a' tz'ik'ankot yaelal,

schekan winh yak' sti' ix. Syalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Tato yel maj ach mulan yet' junokxo winak t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum tik, malaj tas ol ach ik'anok a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' k'a' et'jinak yaelal tik.
Palta tato ix ach mulan yet' junokxo winh winak jun, ix och a mul t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum,
a Jehová ol ach ak'ankanoch ch'oxnab'ilok t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab'. Ol ach b'inaj yuj heb' t'a chukal, ol malk'e a k'ool, ol takjok yib' a xub'.
Haton wal jun yaelal chi' ol jawok t'a ib'anh a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' tik, yujto ha ha' et'jinak yaelal, xcham winh sakerdote chi' t'a ix. Haxo stak'wi ix ix chi': Ujokab' icha chi', xcham ix.
Ha juntzanh katab' chi', tz'ib'chajokab'kan yuj winh sakerdote. Slajwi chi' sb'ikanel winh yet' ha ha' k'a' tz'em t'a yol uk'ab' chi'.
Slajwi chi' syuk'anem ha' ix ix chi', haxo yik slajwi yuk'an ha' ix, skotkan yaelal t'a yib'anh ix.
Schaanek' ixim harina kebada ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal winh sakerdote chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ha jun ofrenda chi' sb'akhoch winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.
Syik'ank'e jun wotzok jun ofrenda winh sakerdote chi', snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yuj sch'oxankot masanil jun ofrenda chi'. Ayik toxo ix yuk'ej ha ha' k'a' chi' ix,

tato ay smul ix t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum chi', skot yaelal t'a yib'anh ix yuj ha ha' syuk'em chi'. Smalk'e sk'ool ix, stakji yib' xub' ix, tz'ochkan ix ch'oxnab'ilok yet' sb'inaj t'a chukal t'a skal chonhab' chi'.
Palta tato yel malaj jab'ok smul ix, malaj jab'ok tas tz'ik'an ix, yuj chi' scheklajeli to malaj smul ix, syalnhej yalji yune' ix.
Haton jun ley tik tz'och t'a yib'anh ix ix smulan t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum, yuj chi' tz'och winh yetb'eyum ix chi' t'a k'ak'alk'olal.

Tato ay junok winak tonhej tzek' t'a yib'anh yak'an k'ak'alk'olal t'a ix yetb'eyum, a jun winak chi' yowalil syik'kot ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yik sb'oan winh sakerdote chi' masanil tas syal jun ley tik.
Tato yel ay smul ix ix chi', ha t'a yib'anh ix skan smul chi'. Haxo t'a yib'anh winh winak chi' malaj tas skani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak ma junok ix ix syak' sti' yak'anoch sb'a t'a yol in k'ab' t'a nazareoal,

maxtzak yal-laj yuk'an wino, ma yuk'an junokxo tas to pajb'inak. Maxtzak yalpax yuk'an wino ochnak winagreal, ma winagre pajb'inak. Max yalpax yuk'an yal sat uwa, ma sloan sat, ma sloan sat t'a takinhal.
Ha t'a jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi', manh wal jab'ok syal yab'lan masanil tastak tz'el t'a te' uwa, wach'chom sk'enal ma stz'umal.
Max yalpax sjoxanel xil sjolom masanto slajwi jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi' t'ayin, schanhej q'uib' xil sjolom yujto wik yaj a in Jehová in tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey junok chamnak,
wach'chom a smam, ma snun schami, ma junok yuk'tak, ma junok yanab', palta max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey yik wach' max kan t'a chukal icha yalan ley. Yowalil wach'nhej yaji yujto wik yaji.
Ha t'a masanil tiempo b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', junelnhej wiknhej yaji.

Talaj ay junok mach junnhej ayek' yet'ok schami, a xil sjolom to wik yaj chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan icha yalan ley. Yuj chi' ayik slajwi yek'b'at ukeok k'ual ayik sb'oxikan icha yalan ley, ichato chi' sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi'.
Haxo t'a yukub'ixial, syik'anb'at chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil t'a junok winh sakerdote t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha winh sakerdote chi' tz'ak'an junok nok' chi' silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'. Haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji tup smul yuj b'aj ix cham jun anima chi' t'a stz'ey. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a xil sjolom sq'uib'xi, wik tz'ajxikani.

Tz'elxi yich jun pekti' b'aj ix yak' sti' t'ayin. Ha jantak tiempo ix ek'b'at t'a yalanhtax chi', maxtzak ochlaj sb'isulok, yujto a xil sjolom wik yaji, ix ixtaxeli. Hanhejtona' yowalil syik'paxb'at junok nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yuj stupan tas ix sk'ulej chi'.
Ayik slajwi jantak tiempoal ix yak' sti' jun anima chi', yowalil sb'at t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Hata' syak'och jun silab' t'a wichanh, snhusjitz'a smasanil, haton junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Hanheja' syak'pax junok nok' nun kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Ha jun chi' silab' yaj yuj yak'ji tup mul. Tz'ak'ji junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail silab'il yik junk'olal.

Hanhejtona', yowalil syak' junok yune' mooch ixim pan malaj yich, a ixim harina te wach' ayoch t'ay kalab'il yet' akeite. Syak'pax ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, ayoch akeite t'ay. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' yofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' wino t'inhantaxon yak'ani.
Ha junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' yuj mul chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in yet' silab' to snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Syak'anpax nok' kalnel silab'il yik junk'olal. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' ixim pan malaj yich chi'. Syak'anpax ofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' pax wino.

Ha jun ix yak' sti' t'a nazareoal chi', sjoxchajel xil sjolom. Ha t'a yichanh in kajnub' sjoxchajeli. Smolk'e xil sjolom ayoch ch'oxnab'ilok to wik yaji, snhusjitz'a t'a kal k'ak', haton k'ak' b'aj stz'a silab' yik junk'olal.

Ayik slajwi sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi', a winh sakerdote tz'ik'ank'e sjenhjab' nok' kalnel tajinakxo chi' yet' jun ixim pan malaj yich ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch chi' yet' pax jun ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, syak'anoch winh masanil t'a yol sk'ab' jun ix yak'och sb'a nazareoal chi'.

Slajwi chi', sb'akhanoch juntzanh chi' winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik. Ha juntzanh chi' sik'b'ilel wikok, yik heb' sakerdote chi' yaji yet' pax snhisk'ol nok' sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh, xub' nok' to sik'chajkaneli, yik winh sakerdote chi' yaji. Ayik toxo ix lajwi masanil juntzanh chi', a jun yak'nakoch sb'a nazareoal chi', tzaxo yal yuk'an wino.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' nazareo: Tato ay junok nazareo chi' syak' sti' yak'an junok ofrenda ek'to t'a yichanhtaxon sleyal, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan icha b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, ayik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' eyetisraelal, syal heb' icha tik:
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, tzex stanhwani.
Ex yilokab'och Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, sch'oxokab' swach'k'olal t'ayex.
Xajanokab' tzex yiloch Jehová, yak'okab' junk'olal t'ayex, xchiokab' heb'.
Icha chi' ol yutej heb' in yak'an b'inaj t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal. Ha inxo ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwi sb'oank'e skajnub' Jehová winhaj Moisés, ix yak'anoch akeite winh t'ay yet' t'a masanil syamk'ab'il yet' t'a yib'anh altar yet' syamk'ab'il.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, haton heb' kolwajnak yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' winak,

ix yak' yofrenda heb' t'a Jehová: Wake' karreta ayk'e yenhul yib'anh yet' lajchawanh nok' mam wakax smunlaj ix yak' heb'. Syalelk'ochi, junjun karreta t'a chatakwanh heb' yajal chi', junjun pax nok' wakax chi' t'a junjun heb'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yichanh skajnub' Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Cha juntzanh karreta yet' juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj chi', tzak'an t'a heb' lewita yik sk'an heb' t'a munlajel t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, icha tastak munlajelal sk'ulej junjun heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix schaan juntzanh karreta chi' winh, ix schaanpax nok' wakax smunlaj chi' winh, ix spojanek' winh t'a skal heb' lewita.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, chab' karreta yet' chanhwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb'.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, chanhe' karreta yet' wajxakwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb' b'aj skuchb'aj yuj winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón.
Haxo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat, malaj karreta, malaj pax nok' wakax ix ak'ji, yujto a heb' sb'akhanb'at masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová t'a sjolom sjenhjab'.
Ayik ix ak'jikanoch yopisio altar, ix yik'b'at yofrenda heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal t'a yichanh altar chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha t'a junjun k'u ch'okch'ok heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal ol yik'kot yofrenda yuj yochkan yopisio altar, xchi.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, ix yik'ankot yofrenda winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab, yajal t'a yinhtilal Judá. T'a schab'il k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar, yajal t'a yinhtilal Isacar. T'a yoxil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón, yajal t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. T'a schanhil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Rubén. T'a yoil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Simeón. T'a swakil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel, yajal t'a yinhtilal Gad. T'a yukil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, yajal t'a yinhtilal Efraín. T'a swajxakil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Manasés. T'a sb'alunhil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni, yajal t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. T'a slajunhil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Dan. T'a yuxluchil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Aser. Haxo t'a slajchawil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Lajannhej yofrenda junjun heb' winh ix yik'koti. Haton junjun plato nab'a plata, 130 siklo yalil junjun yet' pax junjun k'een niwak uk'ab' nab'a plata, 70 siklo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha juntzanh yet'tal chi' te b'ut'an yuj ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite, haton syak' heb' t'a ofrendail. Ix yak'anpax junjun k'een niwak kuchara nab'a oro heb', 10 siklo yalil junjun, b'ut'an yet' inkienso. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' kelem wakax heb', junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, junjun nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal yik snhusjitz'a t'a silab'il. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'och silab'il yuj mul. Stzak'anilxo ix yak' silab' yik junk'olal heb', chawanh nok' toro, owanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, owanh nok' mam chiwa yet' pax owanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix yak' junjun heb'.

Masanil ofrenda ix yak' heb' yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan Israel, ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar, haton juntzanh tik: Lajchawe' k'een plato nab'a plata, lajchawe' uk'ab' nab'a plata yet' lajchawe' niwak kuchara nab'a oro.
Junjun plato chi' 130 siklo yalil, junjun uk'ab' 70 siklo yalil, yuj chi' a k'een plata chi' t'a smasanil, ay 2 mil 400 siklo yalil, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ay pax lajchawe' k'een niwak kuchara nab'a oro b'ut'an yuj inkienso, 10 siklo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha k'een oro t'a smasanil, ay 120 siklo k'een.

Ha sb'isul masanil nok' nok' ix nhusjitz'a silab'il chi', haton tik: Lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, lajchawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, lajchawanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, aynhej ixim trigo tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet'ok yet' pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul.

Haxo pax nok' nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj junk'olal, 24 nok' toro t'a smasanil, 60 nok' ch'ak kalnel, 60 nok' mam chiwa yet' 60 nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Haton masanil juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix ak'chaji ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar ayik toxo ix ochkan yikok Jehová.

Ayik tz'och winhaj Moisés chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', syab' wal winh slolon Jehová yet'ok t'a snanhal chab' yechel querubín ayoch t'a yib'anh b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul skaxail trato.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón to ayik ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al uke' kandil winh, ha t'a yichanh sb'akhnub' kandil chi' syak' yok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Aarón chi' sb'oanoch sk'ak'al juntzanh kandil chi' yik syak'an yok t'a yichanh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha jun b'akhnub' kandil chi' nab'a oro, tenb'il t'a k'een martillo, sb'at t'a yich masanto t'a sfloral t'a schon. Ix b'oji jun b'akhnub' kandil chi' icha wal yechel ix sch'ox Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'kanel heb' lewita t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal tik, tza sakb'itan heb' icha yalan ley.
Icha tik ol aj a sakb'itan heb': Tza tzikoch ha ha' t'a heb' yik sakb'ikan heb', sjoxjiel masanil xil sniwanil heb'. Slajwi chi', sjuk'an spichul heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikan heb'.
Elanhchamel tzik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yet' junok echlab' ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'ji ofrendail t'a ixim trigo. Tz'ak'jipax junokxo nok' kelem wakax silab'il yuj mul.
Tzalan t'a heb' lewita to sja heb' smasanil t'a slak'anil kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, tza molb'anpax masanil heb' eyetisraelal.
Ha heb' lewita chi' tz'och heb' t'a wichanh. Haxo ta' ol yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' eyetchonhab' t'a sjolom heb'.
Ha winhaj Aarón ol ak'anoch heb' lewita chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yofrendaok heb' eyetisraelal chi'. Icha chi' ol aj skan heb' in yak'an serwil.

Slajwi chi', syak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' lewita chi' t'a sjolom chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax chi'. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul heb'.
Slajwi chi' tzak'anoch heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yuj yak'jikan heb' t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol utok ik'ankanel heb' t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok.
Ayik toxo ix lajwi sakb'ikan heb' icha yalan ley yet' yak'jikanoch heb' t'a yol in k'ab', tzaxo yal sja heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik smunlaji.
Haton heb' tik wik tz'ajkan t'a junelnhej t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin.

Yujto wik yaj masanil sb'ab'el winak yune' heb' ix eyetchonhab' tz'alji yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' tato winak nok'. Ayik ix in milancham masanil heb' b'ab'el unin t'a Egipto, hata' ix wak'kan masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok.
Yuj chi' a heb' lewita tik tzin cha sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi' tiknaik.

Ha in ix in sik'kanel heb' lewita tik t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik. Ix wak' heb' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yik a heb' tzin ak'an serwil he k'exulok t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yuj wak'an tup he mul t'a eyib'anh. Ha heb' sja t'a wichanh he k'exulok yik max ex chami tato tzex ja t'a stz'ey in kajnub', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' israel masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yuj heb' lewita.
Ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' lewita chi', ix sjuk'anel spichul heb', haxo winhaj Aarón ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a ofrendail. Ix yak'anpax silab' winh yik stupkanel smul heb'.

Ayik ix lajwi juntzanh chi' smasanil, ix och heb' lewita chi' b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik smunlaj heb' ta'. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal skuchb'an heb'. Icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan heb' sk'ulan yet' heb' lewita chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ol och heb' lewita t'a yopisio t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ayik 25 ab'ilxo sk'inal heb'.
Haxo yik slajwi 50 ab'il sk'inal heb', tz'el heb' t'a yopisio t'a junelnhej.

Ayik sk'och sk'inal heb' t'a icha chi', syal skolwaj heb' yet' heb' smunlaj t'a mantiado chi', palta maxtzak munlaj heb' t'a smunlajel ichataxon ix sk'ulej. Icha chi' tzutej ak'anoch heb' lewita t'a smunlajel, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwi yab'ilal yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, yik b'ab'el uj t'a yol schab'il ab'il, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lum Sinaí icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' israel to syak'och q'uinh heb' yik snaankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' t'a libre ichataxon sk'ual to chekel yajkani.
Tzeyak'och jun q'uinh chi' t'a jun k'u chi' ayik wanxo yem k'u, haton yik 14 yoch jun uj tik, tze k'anab'ajan masanil icha yajkan t'a sleyal, xchi t'a winh.
Ichato chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal to tz'och jun q'uinh chi'.
Ix yak'och jun q'uinh chi' heb' t'a yemk'ualil t'a 14 yoch jun uj chi' t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok chamnak heb' winh, maj yal-laj yak'anoch q'uinh heb' winh t'a jun k'ual chi'. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón t'a jun k'u chi' yik sk'anb'an heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha onh tik ix ko yam jun chamnak, yuj chi' manh wach'ok kaj icha yalan ley. ¿Tokwal manh ol chajok kak' kofrenda t'a Jehová t'a jun k'u tik yet' masanil heb' ketchonhab'? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Tanhwejek, ol wab' tas xchi Jehová eyuuj, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal.

E masanil a ex tik yet' heb' eyinhtilal, yowalil tzeyak'och jun q'uinh tik yik tze naankoti ayik wik'annak ex el t'a libre a in Jehová in tik. Ha mach manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok chamnak, ma heb' najat ayb'at t'a junok b'aj schek sb'a,
ol xo yak'och q'uinh heb' t'a 14 yoch schab'il uj t'a yemk'ualil. Yowalil schi nok' silab' heb' yet' anh itaj k'a' yet' ixim pan malaj yich.
Malaj jab'okxo nok' skan yuj heb' t'a junxo k'ual, max smak'poj sb'akil nok' heb'. Icha ix aj walani, icha wal chi' tz'aj eyak'anoch q'uinh chi'.

Palta tato ay mach max ak'anoch jun q'uinh chi', wach'chom wach' yaj icha yalan ley, mato manh ayokb'at t'a junok b'aj schek sb'a, manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal, yujto maj yak' yofrenda t'ayin t'a jun k'u to chekel yajkan chi', skan smul chi' t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, snib'ej heb' syak'och jun q'uinh chi' heyet'ok yik tzin yik'anchaanh, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' icha sleyal ix wala'. Ha ley ix wak' he k'anab'ajej chi', ha' sk'anab'ajej pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan chi' t'a he kal, xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a sk'ual ayik ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Jehová, syalelk'ochi haton Mantiado yik trato, ix och jun asun t'a yib'anh. Ayik ix emkan k'u, lajan ix aj yilji icha k'ak', masanto ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u.
Ichanhej chi' ix aji. Aynhejoch jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh kajnub' chi' a tzek' k'u, haxo t'ak'walil ichato ayoch sk'ak'al jun asun chi'.
Ayik sk'e waan jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh kajnub' chi', sb'eyb'at heb' israel chi'. Haxo b'aj tz'ochxi waan, hata' sb'oxik'e skampamento heb'.
Ha Jehová sch'oxan t'a heb' tato sb'eyb'at heb', mato tz'och waan heb'. Ha b'aj tz'och waan jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová, hata' skannhej heb'.
Tato niwan tiempo tz'och waan jun asun chi', sk'anab'ajej heb' t'a Jehová skan ta'.
Tato jun chab'nhej k'ual tzek' jun asun chi' jun, icha chi' sk'ulejpax heb', slajwi chi' sb'eypaxb'at heb', icha tz'aj sch'oxan Jehová t'a heb'.
Ay b'aj junnhej ak'wal tzek' jun asun chi', haxo t'a q'uinhib'alil sb'atxi, icha chi' tz'aj sb'eyxib'at heb'. Tato t'a k'ualil ma t'ak'walil sb'at jun asun chi', sb'atpax heb'.
Tato skannhej waan jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová chab'ok k'ual, ma junok ujal, ma junok ab'il, hata' skannhej heb', max b'atlaj heb'. Tato sb'atxi jun asun chi', sb'atxi heb'.
Masanto ha' Jehová tz'alani, tz'och waan heb'. Hanheja' tz'alanpaxi, sb'atxi heb'. Ix sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' t'a Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
B'ochajokab' chab'ok k'een trompeta nab'a plata, stenchaj t'a k'een martillo. Ha juntzanh k'een trompeta chi' spukhaji a tze molb'an heb' anima, ayik tzex b'eypaxb'ati.
Ha spuji chab' k'een trompeta chi', masanil chonhab' sja molan t'a ichanh b'aj ay in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Palta tato junnhej k'een spuji, anhej heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makanhil inhtilal smolb'ej sb'a.
Tato junip syak' spuji k'een trompeta chi', sk'e waan kampamento ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u b'aj ay in kajnub' syal chi'.
Haxo yik spukhaj k'een t'a schaelal sb'at heb' ayek' t'a stojolal sur. Yuj chi' a spukhaj k'een trompeta t'a icha chi', ch'oxnab'il yaji ayik sb'eyb'at heb' chonhab'.
Tato manh junipok syak' spukhaj k'een, syalelk'ochi to tonhej smolb'aj anima.
Ha mach spu'an k'een trompeta chi', haton heb' sakerdote yinhtil winhaj Aarón. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo.

Tato ay heb' ajk'ol sjawi yak' owal t'ayex t'a yol he makb'en, tzex el eyak' owal chi' yet' heb', elanhchamel spukhaj k'een trompeta, yik tzex in nakot a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, tzex in kolanel t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Haxo t'a sk'ual ay he tzalajk'olal, icha t'a sk'ual q'uinh, ma t'a yik tz'alji k'een uj, tze pu'an k'een trompeta chi' yik tzeyak'an silab' stz'ai, ma silab' yik junk'olal. Icha chi' tzex in nakoti. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in tik swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ayik 20 yoch schab'il uj yik schab'il ab'il yelta chonhab' Israel t'a Egipto, ix k'e waan jun asun t'a yib'anh kajnub' yik trato.
Ichato chi' ix el heb' israel t'a tzinan lum yik Sinaí, k'ojank'olal ix b'eykot heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a tzinan lum yik Parán, yujto hata' ix och waan jun asun chi'.
Sb'ab'elalto sb'ey heb' tik t'a stzolal icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
B'ab'el heb' soldado et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Judá. Ha winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Haxo t'a yichanh heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Isacar, hata' ayoch winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar.
Ha winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Zabulón.
Ixlajwi chi', ix xuyank'e waan skajnub' Jehová heb', haxo heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari ix ik'anb'ati, yujto a heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'anb'eyok.
Ichato chi' ix kot heb' soldado et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Rubén. Ha winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Simeón.
Ha winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Gad.
Tzak'anto skotpax heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat. Ha heb' et'jinak masanil syamk'ab'il skajnub' Jehová. Haxo ix k'och heb', toxo ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Jehová chi'.
Ichato chi' ix kot heb' soldado et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Efraín. Ha winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Manasés.
Ha winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Benjamín.

Slajwub'alxo masanil juntzanh soldado chi', ix kot heb' et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Dan. Haton heb' stanhwan heb' chonhab' t'a spatik chi'. Ha winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Aser.
Haxo winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Neftalí.
Icha chi' tz'aj stzolan sb'a heb' israel ayik sb'eyb'at heb'.

Ay jun k'ual, ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winh sb'aluch, haton winhaj Hobab yuninal winhaj Ragüel aj Madián, winh snhi' winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha onh tik wan ko b'at t'a jun lu'um ix yak' sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayonh. Konh ket'ok, wach' ol ach kila', yujto ix yak' sti' Jehová onh syailani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Hobab chi' icha tik: --Maay, a in tik ol in paxkan t'a in chonhab', b'aj ay masanil heb' in k'ab' wok, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Manh onh aktejkani, yujto a ach tik ojtak yek' masanil juntzanh lugar b'aj wach' koch waan t'a tzinan lu'um tik, a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej.
Tato tzach b'at ket'ok, a tastak wach' ol yak' Jehová t'ayonh, ol kak'pax iko', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' t'a Sinaí, haton jun tzalan b'aj ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Oxe' k'ual ix b'ey heb'. B'ab'el te' skaxail strato Jehová yuj heb', a sch'oxan junok b'aj wach' syik' yip heb'.
Ayik sb'eyb'at heb', tz'och jun asun yik Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' t'a k'ualil.

Ayik tz'ik'jib'at te' kaxa chi' syalan winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Q'ueanh wan Mamin Jehová. Pech saklem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ha heb' malaj snib'ej t'ayach, elokab' lemnaj heb' t'a ichanh, xchi winh.
Ayik tz'och waan te' kaxa chi', syalanxi winh icha tik: Emanhkot Mamin Jehová, ajanh t'a ko kal a onh israel manhxo jantakok onh tik, manhxo onh b'ischajb'enok, xchi winh.

Ay jun k'u ix och ijan heb' israel yalan chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yuj yaelal tzek' t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' Jehová chi', ix te kot yowal t'a heb', ix yak'kot jun niwan k'ak' t'a skal heb', ix tz'ab'at heb' kajan t'a stitakel kampamento chi'.
Ix k'e yaw heb' chonhab' t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix sk'anan skolwal winh heb'. Haxo winh ix k'anan t'a Jehová, ix tup jun k'ak' chi'.
Yuj chi' Tabera ix skuchkan jun lugar chi', yujto hata' ix yak' pitzwok jun k'ak' chi' Jehová t'a skal heb'.

Tzijtum heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayxo och t'a skal heb' israel. Ha jun makan anima chi', anhej wael naan yuj heb'. Ajun pax heb' israel ix alub'tanhani, ix ok'k'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Komonok wal ay mach tz'ak'an jab'ok nok' chib'ej ko chi'a.
Sko nawalkoti to te ay nok' chay max ko manlaj ix ko chi' t'a Egipto. Ay pax anh pepino, te' melón, anh puerro, anh kebolla yet' anh axux, masanil juntzanh chi' ix kab'lej.
Haxo pax t'a tik, te manhxa jab'ok tas skab'lej, toxonhej skixtej ko k'ool ko waan jun maná tik, xchi heb'.
(Ha juntzanh maná chi', lajan yilji icha sat anh kulantro, k'an yilji icha stzatajil te' taj.

Haxo sjab', lajan icha sjab' ixim k'oxox pan sb'o yet' akeite. Ha tz'em yal ak'wal, tz'emkan maná chi' t'a skampamento heb'. Ayik sakb'i tz'elta heb' anima chi' smol yiko', sjaxan chojok heb', sb'oan heb' icha tz'aj sb'o ixim pan t'a horno. Ay b'aj stenpoj heb', stz'anhan heb'.)
Ix yab' winhaj Moisés yok' masanil heb' israel t'a sti' smantiado junjun. Ix te kot yowal Jehová, hanheja' ix te ja schab'k'olal winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzak' wil yaelal a in a chekab' in tik? ¿Tas wal yowal a k'ol t'a in patik, yuj chi' tzak' jun chonhab' tik in tanhwej?
Tokwal mamab'il nunab'il waji, yuj chi' tzala' to tzin chelb'at heb' icha junok nene' unin t'a sat lum lum alnakkan t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
¿B'ajtil sb'at wik' nok' chib'ej swak' schi juntzanh anima tik? Tz'ok' wal heb', tzul yalan heb' t'ayin: Ak'kot nok' chib'ej yik sko chi'a, xchi heb'.
Maxtzak yal-laj in tak'wanoch t'a wib'anh wik'anb'at jun chonhab' tik. Icha junok ikatz te al, icha wal chi' yaj swab'i.
Tato ol ak'nhej jun yaelal tik t'ayin, wach' hama tzin ak' chamok. Tato xajan in uuj jun, iq'uinel t'a skal tzijtum yaelal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Molb'ej 70-ok heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', heb' winh niwak yelk'och t'a skal heb' anima tzila', tzik'ankot heb' winh t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, tzin a tanhwan ta' yet' heb' winh.

Haxo yik ol in k'ochok, ol in lolon het'ok. Ol wik'el jab'ok espíritu ayoch t'ayach, ol wak'anoch t'a heb' winh, yik wach' ol kolwaj heb' winh yilan heb' anima tik het'ok, yik manh a ch'okojok ol il heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzalan t'a heb' anima chi' to sb'o sb'a heb', yujto a k'ik'an schi nok' chib'ej heb' ix sk'an chi'. Toxo ix wab' yok' heb', ix wab'an yalan heb': Komonok ay jab'ok chib'ej sko chi'a. Te wach'nhej kajek' t'a Egipto, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ol wak' nok' schib'ej heb' chi'.
Manh junnhejok k'ual, manh chab'ok k'ual, manh oyeok k'ual, manh lajunheok k'ual, manh junq'uinhok,

palta jun ujal ol schi nok' chib'ej chi' heb'. Ol schi nok' heb' masanto ol xej heb' yuj nok'. Ol laj ja nok' t'a yoltak snhi' heb', masanto ol syaj nok' heb'. Yujto emnakiltak ix in yutej heb' a in Jehová in ayinek' t'a he kal. Tz'ok' heb' t'a wichanh syalan heb': ¿Tas yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto? xchi heb', xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, a heb' anima wet'nak tik, ay 600 mil heb' winak stiempoal yoch soldadoal. Ch'ok pax yaj heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin, tzalani to jun ujal ol ak' nok' chib'ej ko chi'a.

¿B'ajtil ol kot jantakok nok' kalnel yet' jantakok nok' wakax sko milchamok yik syab' schi'an juntzanh anima tik? Yet' pax kak'an nok' chay schi heb', wach'chom slajwik'eta nok' smasanil t'a yol ha' mar, hanhejtona' max yab'laj nok', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Am a naani to jab'nhej in poder? Ha tiknaik ol ila' tato ol elk'och icha swal tik, mato maay, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Moisés yal t'a skal heb' anima tas ix yal Jehová. Ix smolb'an 70 heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winh, ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a spatiktak skajnub' Dios yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix emul Jehová t'a skal asun, ix lolon yet' winhaj Moisés chi'. Hata' ix ik'jiel jab'ok espíritu ayoch t'a winh yuj Jehová, ix yak'anoch t'a heb' winh 70 ichamtak winak chi'. Hata' ix och ijan heb' winh slolon icha heb' yalumalel slolonel Dios, palta anhej junel chi' ix lolon heb' winh icha chi'.

Ay chawanh heb' winh ayoch sb'isulok heb' winh 70 chi', jun winh skuch Eldad, haxo junxo winh skuchan Medad. Ha heb' winh chawanh chi', ix kan heb' winh t'a kampamento, maj b'atlaj heb' winh t'a skajnub' Dios. Ajun pax heb' winh ix chaan espíritu chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalanel slolonel Dios t'a kampamento chi'.

Haxo ix yab'an jun winh kelem, ix b'at lemnaj winh yal t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Eldad yet' winhaj Medad, wan slolon heb' winh b'aj ay kampamento, ichato yalumalel slolonel Dios heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, winh skolwaj yiktax t'a skelemal yet' winhaj Moisés chi', ix yal winh icha tik: --Mamin Moisés, a tiknaik alb'ati to skachjioch waan heb' winh chi' sloloni, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --¿Tom a gana a innhej niwan welk'och t'a skal heb' anima tik? Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Jehová to syak' Yespíritu t'a masanil anima tik yik wach' tz'ochkan heb' schekab'ok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winh yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' b'aj ay kampamento chi'.

Junanto wal rato chi' ix kot jun ik' te ow t'a yol ha' mar yuj Jehová, haxo jun ik' chi' ix ik'ankot nok' tzijtumal much skuchan ub'. Ix em nok' t'a yol kampamento yet' t'a spatiktak, ay am junok k'ual stek'nab'il spatiktak kampamento chi' b'aj ix k'och k'aman yem nok'. Junxonhej am wal metro schaanhil tzek' jenhenhok nok' t'a yib'anh lu'um.

Masanil t'a jun k'u chi' yet' masanil jun ak'wal yet' masanil t'a junxo k'u ix syam nok' heb' anima chi'. Ha mach kennhej nok' ix yamchaj yuj, aynhejam lajunheok b'ulanh nok' ix syama'. Masanil heb' anima ix och ijan sb'oan nok', ix yak'an takjok nok' heb' t'a spatiktak kampamento chi'.
Ayik wan schi'an nok' ub' chi' heb', ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a heb', ix yak'ankot jun yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Te niwan heb' ix chami.
Yuj chi' ix skuchkan jun lugar chi' Quibrot-hataawa, yujto hata' ix mukchajkan heb' pek'chib'ej chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' t'a Quibrot-hataawa chi', ix b'at heb', ix k'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuch Hazerot. Hata' ix kajnajkan heb' jun pekti'.
Ix och ijan ix María yet' winhaj Aarón yalan spekal winhaj Moisés, yujto yik'nak jun ix kusita winh yetb'eyumok.
Hanheja' ix yalanpax heb': Tokwal anhej t'a winhaj Moisés chi' slolon Jehová. Slolonpax t'ayonh, xchi heb'. Palta ix yab' Jehová tas ix yal heb' chi'.
T'a wal yel, anhej winhaj Moisés te emnakil syutej sb'a t'a skal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi', elanhchamel ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a ix María chi' icha tik: Kotanhek eyoxwanhil t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, xchi. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' yoxwanhil.
Ixlajwi chi' ix emul Jehová t'a skal jun niwan asun, ix och moyan t'a sti' skajnub' chi', ix awtaj winhaj Aarón yet' ix María chi' yuj. Haxo ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh, ix yalan icha tik:
Ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ayik swak'ankot junok in chekab' t'a he kal, a in tzin ch'ox in b'a t'ay, tzin lolonpax t'a wayichal t'ay.
Haxo pax yet' winh in chekab' aj Moisés tik, manh ichokta' swutej, yujto anhej winh k'anab'ajum syutej sb'a t'a skal heb' wik yaji.

Q'uelk'umb'a tzin aj yet' winh tzin loloni, te jichichi tz'aj in loloni yet' in yilan winh. Tato k'elk'umb'a tz'aj in sat in lolon yet' winh ¿tas wal yuj tze tek'b'ej he b'a eyalan spekal winh? xchi t'a heb'.
Ix te kot yowal Jehová t'a heb', ix lajwi chi' ix b'ati.
Ayik ix k'e waan asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios, haxo ix María chi' sakwekinak yilji sniwanil ix yuj lepra. Ix och k'elan winhaj Aarón chi' t'a ix, ix yilan winh to ayxo och lepra t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Mamin, ak' wal niwank'olal t'ayonh, yujto yuj ko manh pensaril ix och ko mul.
Komonok tz'el t'a a k'ol max kan ix icha junok nene' unin chamnakxo ayik tz'alji, ixtaxnakxob'at sniwanil, xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés chi' yalan t'a Jehová: Mamin, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzik'el jun ilya tik t'a ix wanab' tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: Q'uinalok tato a smam ix stzub'anoch t'a sat, ¿tom max kan ix q'uixwelal ukeok k'ual? Okxom yuj jun smul ix ix och tik, yowalil tz'el ix ukeok k'ual t'a spatikel kampamento. Slajwi chi', schajixioch ix, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' uke' k'ual ix ik'jiel ix María chi' t'a spatikel kampamento chi'. Ayik ayelta ix t'a spatikel kampamento chi', maj b'eyb'atlaj heb' chonhab' chi'.
Haxo yik ix ochxi ix t'a yol kampamento chi', ix el heb' chonhab' chi' t'a Hazerot, ix b'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Parán.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ak'b'at jaywanhok heb' winh winak, yik sb'at heb' winh yil lum Canaán, lum ol wak' t'ayex. Tza sik'el junjunok heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, tza chekanb'at heb' winh, xchi t'a winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés cheknab'il ix yal Jehová chi'. Ix schekb'at heb' winh ix sik'el winh chi', ix el heb' winh t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán, ix b'at heb' winh yila' tas yilji lum Canaán chi'. Yajal yaj heb' winh smasanil t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.
Icha tik sb'i heb' winh yet' tastak yinhtilal:

Ha winhaj Samúa yuninal winhaj Zacur, t'a yinhtilal Rubén. Ha winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Horí, t'a yinhtilal Simeón. Ha winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone, t'a yinhtilal Judá. Ha winhaj Igal yuninal winhaj José, t'a yinhtilal Isacar. Ha winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Nun, t'a yinhtilal Efraín. Ha winhaj Palti yuninal winhaj Rafú, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Ha winhaj Gadiel yuninal winhaj Sodi, t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. Ha winhaj Gadi yuninal winhaj Susi, t'a yinhtilal José, syalelk'ochi t'a yinhtilal Manasés. Ha winhaj Amiel yuninal winhaj Gemali, t'a yinhtilal Dan. Ha winhaj Setur yuninal winhaj Micael, t'a yinhtilal Aser. Ha winhaj Nahbi yuninal winhaj Wapsi, t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Ha winhaj Geuel yuninal winhaj Maki, t'a yinhtilal Gad.
Haton sb'i heb' winh ix schekb'at winhaj Moisés yil lum Canaán. (Ix k'exwi sb'i winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Nun yuj winhaj Moisés chi', Josué ix sb'iejkan winh yuj winh.)
Ayik ix yak'anb'at heb' winh ilum lu'um winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Canaán, ix yal winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixikek, ha t'a Neguev tzex b'ati, tzex k'ek'och t'a tzalkixtak,
tzeyilani tas yilji lu'um. Tzeyilanpaxi tas yilji anima kajan ta', tek'an am heb' mato maay. Scham eyilanpaxi, tzijtum am heb' mato jaywannhej heb'.
Tzeyilani, yoltak am mantiado kajan heb' anima chi' mato oyanoch muro t'a spatik schonhab' heb'. Tato wach' lu'um mato maay,

tato yax sat lu'um mato takinh. Tzeyilani tato ay ste'al lu'um. Tzeyak' eyip eyik'ankot sat tas awab'il t'a sat lu'um chi', tzeyik'kot jab'ok kila', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ha t'a stiempoal sb'ab'el sat te' uwa, hata' ix xit'ek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix el heb' winh t'a lum tzinan lum yik Zin masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a Rehob t'a slak'anil Hamat.

Ix k'ek'och heb' winh t'a Neguev masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a Hebrón. Hata' ay schonhab' winhaj Ahimán, winhaj Sesai yet' winhaj Talmai, yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac. Ha chonhab' Hebrón chi', ukexo ab'il sb'oi ayik sb'onak chonhab' Zoán t'a Egipto.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a jun ch'olan skuch Escol, hata' ix xikel jun k'ojlab' sat te' uwa heb' winh, ix stzek'anoch heb' winh t'a jun te te'. Chawanh heb' winh ix ik'ankoti, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix yik'anpaxkot sat te' granado heb' winh yet' sat te' higo.
Escol ix skuchkan jun ch'olan chi', yujto hata' ix xikel jun k'ojlab' sat te' uwa chi' heb' winh ilum lu'um chi'.
Ixlajwi yilan lum lum chi' heb' winh t'a 40 k'ual, ix meltzaj heb' winh

t'a Cades, t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán. Hata' ayek' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalani chajtil yilji lum lum chi', ix sch'oxan sat te' awb'en te' ix yik'kot heb' winh chi' t'a lu'um.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix b'at kil lum lum ix ala', wal yel te wach' lu'um, te yax sat lu'um, ina sat tastak tz'el t'a sat lum tik.

Palta a heb' anima kajan ta' te tek'an heb', yelxo wal niwak chonhab' yilji schonhab' heb'. Ayoch smuroal spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi'. Hanhejtona' ix kilpax heb' winh winak te chaanh steel, haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac.

Ha heb' amalekita kajan t'a sat lum Neguev, haxo t'a sikil lum yet' t'a tzalkixtak, hata' kajan heb' hitita yet' heb' jebuseo yet' pax heb' amorreo. Haxo pax t'a stitak ha ha' mar yet' t'a stitak ha' Jordán, a heb' kananeo kajan t'ay, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Caleb t'a masanil heb' israel linhanoch t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi' to numan tz'aj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik koyek, kikxo yaj lu'um. Ol elnhej heb' winh chi' kuuj, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi juntzanh heb' winh ix xit'ek' chi' icha tik: --Manh ol yal-laj kak'an owal yet' heb' chonhab' chi' yujto te tek'an heb' t'a kichanh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel chi' to a jun lum lum ix b'at yil heb' winh chi' chuklaj lu'um. Ix yalanpax heb' winh: --Ha lum xit' kil chi', scham anima yuj lu'um. Masanil heb' anima ix kil ta', te niwak winaknhej heb'.

Ix kilanpax heb' te chaanh steel, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac. Ha tzonh och linhan t'a stz'ey heb', lajan tzonh ajkan ichok nok' chil t'a skal yok heb'. Hanheja' icha chi' tzonh yutej yilanpaxoch heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' israel, ix k'e yaw heb' smasanil, ok'elnhej yaj heb' ix ek' jun ak'wal chi'.
Ix laj k'e nhilnaj heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Wach' am wal tato ha t'a Egipto onh chamkani, ma jun t'a tzinan lum tik tzonh chami.

¿Tas yuj tzonh yik'b'at Jehová t'a jun lum lum chi', a am yuj ko cham t'a skal owal ta', yik skan heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' kuninal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajan ta'? Yelxom wal wach' tato tzonh meltzaj t'a Egipto, xchi heb' israel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' smol halan icha tik: Ko say junok mach tzonh kuchb'an meltzaj t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a sat lum t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' smasanil.
Haxo pax winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone, haton heb' winh ix xit'ek' iloj lu'um chi', ix snhik'chitejel spichul heb' winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' anima smasanil icha tik: --Ha lum lum ix b'at kil chi', te wach' lu'um.
Te yax sat lu'um. Tato tz'el t'a sk'ol Jehová skolwaj ket'ok, ol kik'nhej lu'um, ha' ol ak'an lum t'ayonh.

Yuj wal chi', manh eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik Jehová, manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima ay t'a jun lu'um chi'. Icha ko waan junok pan, icha chi' ol aj ko satanel heb'. ¿Tok ay mach ol kolan heb' t'ayonh? Ha onhxo pax tik ayoch Jehová ket'ok. Manh ex xiw t'a heb', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' a heb' anima chi' ix yal heb' to sjulk'enej heb' winh chawanh chi' heb'. T'a wal jun rato chi', t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' smasanil, ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' stzikikial t'a sti' skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.

Ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej juntzanh anima tik in spatikaneli? ¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej heb' in schab'k'olani, tik wal syil heb' jantak tas satub'tak ix in ch'ox t'a skal heb'?
Ha tiknaik ol wak'kot junok niwan ilya t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yik sateli. Ha t'ayach ol el junok chonhab' wuuj to yelxo niwan, te tek'an ol aj t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --Yojtak wal heb' aj Egipto jantak a poder ayik ix elta heb' chonhab' tik t'a skal heb'. Ayik ol yab'an heb' to tza satel heb' a chonhab' tik,

ol yalan a pekal heb' t'a heb' anima ay t'a yol yik Canaán. Ha heb' chi', ix yab'pax heb' to a ach Jehová ach tik, ayach ek' t'a ko kal, k'elk'umb'a tzach aj ket'ok tzach loloni. Ayachnhej ek' t'a skal jun asun ayek' t'a kib'anh. T'a k'ualil ayachoch t'a skal jun niwan topanh asun chi', tzach b'eynhej t'a kichanh. Haxo t'ak'walil, t'a skal jun niwan k'ak' ayachochi, tzach b'eynhej t'a kichanh a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Masanil juntzanh tik ix yab' spekal heb' aj Canaán chi',
palta tato junelnhej tza satel heb' a chonhab' tik, icha tz'aj satel junok anima, haxo heb' anima ol ab'an spekal, tzijtum tas ol yal heb'. Olam yal heb' icha tik:
Maj yal-laj yik'jioch heb' anima yuj Jehová t'a sat lum b'aj ix yak' sti' yak'an t'a heb', yuj chi' ix satjiel heb' yuj t'a tzinan lu'um, xcham heb'.
Yuj chi', a tiknaik Mamin Jehová, tzin tewi t'ayach to tza ch'ox a poder, icha b'aj ix ak' a ti', ix halani

to max kotlaj owal t'a elanhchamel, te xajan heb' anima uuj, tz'ak'an niwank'olal smul heb' chuk yet' heb' pit. Palta max ek'b'atlaj ak'an syaelal junok mach yuj smul b'aj junelnhej pit syutej sb'a t'ayach, tzak'nhejkan yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal yet' yixchikin, masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal.

Ak' niwank'olal smul juntzanh anima tik, icha wal a niwan wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', icha ix aj ak'an niwank'olal heb' yiktax onh el t'a Egipto masanto ix onh ja t'a tzinan lum tik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ujokab'i, swak' niwank'olal smul heb' anima tik icha wal halan chi'.
Palta swak'och in b'a testigoal yet' in poder te niwan yelk'ochi to chekel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal,

wach'chom a jantak heb' tik ix yil in poder heb' yet' juntzanh tas satub'tak ix in b'o t'a Egipto yet' t'a tzinan lum tik, palta ma chekel jayelalxo in yak'an prowal heb', max sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' tas swala'.
Yuj chi' manh ol k'ochlaj heb' t'a lum ix wak' in ti' wak'an t'a smam yicham heb'. Malaj junok heb' tzin patikanel tik ol k'och t'a sat lu'um.
Palta anhej winh in chekab' aj Caleb ol k'och t'a sat lu'um chi', yujto k'anab'ajum winh t'ayin, wach'nhej spensar winh. Ha winh ol makb'enan lum yet' heb' yuninal, haton lum ix xit' yil winh chi'.
kajan heb' amalekita yet' heb' kananeo t'a ch'olkixtak t'a lak'an tik, yuj chi' k'ik'an tzex meltzaji. Haxo t'a tzinan lum t'a stojolalb'at ha' Chakchak Mar tzex b'ati, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
--¿Jantakto tiempo ol techaj juntzanh anima malaj swach'il spensar tik wuuj? Ix wab' yalan in pekal heb'.
Ixikek, alek t'a heb' icha tik: Ha in Jehová in, ix wak' in ti' to ol elk'och icha ix aj wab'an eyalan chi'.

Masanil heb' winh winak ek'xo sk'inal t'a 20 ab'il, heb' winh ix ik'jik'e waan slistail, haton heb' winh ix halan chuk t'a in patik, ol cham heb' winh. Ol kan k'otjab' sb'akil heb' t'a tzinan lu'um tik.

Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, ol och t'a lum lum ix wak' in ti' wak'an chi' t'ayex. Ha exxo he masanil, mach ex to chuk tas ix eyal t'a in patik, manh ol ex ochlaj t'a lu'um.
Ha heb' eyuninal ix eyala' to ol ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, a heb' ol wak'och t'a lum lum maj schalaj he k'ol chi'. Ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' ta'.
Ha exxo pax tik jun, ol kan he niwanil t'a tzinan lu'um tik.

Ha heb' eyuninal tik, 40 ab'il ol ek' heb' tanhwoj kalnel t'a tzinan lu'um tik, icha chi' ol aj stupanel he mul chi' heb', haton b'aj ix in he patikejel chi', masanto ol ex chamkan t'a tik he masanil.

T'a 40 k'ual ix heyila' tas yilji lum xit' eyil chi', yuj chi' 40 ab'il ol och yaelal t'a eyib'anh, syalelk'ochi junjun ab'il t'a junjun k'u. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakkaneli to swak' syaelal heb' tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha in Jehová in tik swala', icha chi' ol wutok t'ayex. Yujto ix he molb'ejoch he b'a ajk'olal t'ayin, yuj chi' ha t'a tzinan lum tik ol ex satkanelok, xchi Jehová t'a heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh ix xit'ek' iloj lum yuj winhaj Moisés chi', chuknhej ix aj yalan heb' winh tas yaj lu'um, yuj chi' ix b'uchwaj heb' anima t'a Jehová.

Haxo Jehová ix ak'ankot jun ilya t'a yib'anh heb' winh ilum lu'um chi', yuj chi' ix cham heb' winh. Haxonhej winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone maj chamlaj yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ayik ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' israel tas ix yal Jehová, masanil heb' ix kusk'e sk'ool.

Haxo ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e waan heb', ix snaan heb' to sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' anima kajan t'a tzalkixtak. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, wal yel koyek t'a sat lum b'aj ix yak' sti' Jehová to ol yak' t'ayonh. Yeltoni ix och ko mul, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tze tenek' tas ix yal Jehová? Ha jun tas tze na chi', manh wach'ok ol elk'ochok.
Manh ex b'atok, yujto manh ol ochlaj Jehová heyet'ok, ol ex ak'jok ganar yuj heb' ajk'ool.

Maklab'ilexxo yuj heb' amalekita yet' heb' kananeo, to ol yak' owal heb' heyet'ok. Ol ex smilcham heb' yujto ix eyik'el he pensar t'a Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ayokochlaj heyet'ok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Palta ix spitejnhej sb'a heb', ix b'at heb' t'a tzalkixtak. Haxo te' skaxail strato Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés chi', maj eltalaj t'a yol kampamento.

Ayik ix b'at heb' winh chi', maklab'il sk'ek'och heb' winh yuj heb' amalekita yet' heb' kananeo, yuj chi' ix yak' owal heb'. Haxo ix aji, ix ak'ji ganar heb' israel, ix pechchaj heb' masanto t'a Horma.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik ol ex k'och t'a lum lum ol wak' t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay,

tato ayex tze nhustz'a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa silab'il, mato yik tze k'anab'ajan b'aj tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ool, ma yuj junok q'uinh yuj chi' tzeyak'a', yowalil tzeyak'pax chab'ok libra harina te wach' kalab'il yet' junok litro akeite yet' silab' chi'. Ha jun silab' chi' te suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.
Ha yet' juntzanh silab' toxo ix wal chi' tzeyak' junok litro wino ofrendail yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi'.
Tato a junok nok' ch'ak kalnel tzeyak' silab'il, tzeyak'pax wajxakeok libra harina skalaj yet' junok litro akeite yet' jab'okxo,
ek'topax jun litro wino tzeyak' yet'ok. Te suk'uq'ui sjab' jun ofrenda chi' swab'i.
Tato a junok nok' kelem wakax tzeyak' silab'il to stz'ai, ma silab'il yik tze k'anab'ajej b'aj tzeyak' he ti', ma silab'il yik junk'olal,
tzeyak'pax lajchaweok libra harina, chab'ok litro akeite
yet' pax chab'ok litro wino ofrendail yet'ok. Ha jun ofrenda chi' suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.
Haton juntzanh tik yowalil tzeyak' yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', ma yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma yet' junjun nok' yunetak kalnel, ma yet' junjun nok' yunetak chiwa.
Icha sb'isul nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', icha pax chi' sb'isul juntzanhxo ofrenda chi' tzeyak' yet'ok.
E masanil a ex israel ex tik, yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh ley tik smasanil ayik tze nhusantz'a eyofrenda suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.

Tato ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej sb'eyek' t'a he kal, mato kajan heyet'ok, tato snib'ej snhusantz'a junok silab' to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i, yowalil sk'anab'ajej masanil sleyal icha tze k'anab'ajej a ex tik.

Ha jun ley chi' tz'och yopisio eyuuj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan eyet' chi'. Ha jun ley chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, lajan eyelk'och t'a yol in sat a in Jehová in tik.
Junnhej ley heyik yaj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik kajanexxo ek' t'a lum b'aj ol ex wik'b'ati,
a ixim trigo syak' t'a lum lum chi' ol he wa''a, yowalil tzeyik'kanel jab'ok ixim t'a ofrendail yik tzeyak' t'ayin,
icha tz'aj yak'chaj ixim sb'ab'laj tek'jieli, icha chi' tz'aj eyak'an ixim t'ayin. Hanhejtona' tzeyak'pax jun b'ab'el pan sb'o t'a ixim harina yik ixim ak' trigo chi' ofrendail t'ayin.
Ha jun makan ofrenda chi' ol eyak'nhej t'ayin a in Jehová in tik t'a masanil tiempo.
Talaj sb'at satk'olal eyuj he k'ulan junok cheknab'il ix wal t'a winhaj Moisés tik t'a sb'ab'elal,
yuj chi' maxtzak he k'anab'ajej yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal ayik ol b'eynhejb'atok, haton tik ol he k'ulej:

Tato ay junok cheknab'il sb'at satk'olal eyuj he k'ulan he masanil, yowalil snhusjitz'a junok nok' kelem wakax eyuj he masanil t'a silab'il to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik yet' ixim trigo yet' wino tzeyak'taxon ofrendail yet' silab' chi', icha t'a sleyal. Tzeyak'an junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul.

Haxo junok winh sakerdote sb'oan jun chi' eyuj he masanil ichataxon t'a sleyal yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh. Ha in ton swak' tupel he mul chi' yujto manh sk'anok he k'ool tze k'ulani, yujto ix eyak'pax silab' yuj he mul.
Ha yuj he silab' chi', stupkanel he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, yujto he masanil ix och he mul.
Palta tato junnhej anima tz'och smul, yuj sb'at satk'olal yuj sk'anab'ajan junok cheknab'il, a yuj smul chi', yowalil syak' junok nok' kob'es chiwa jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il.
Haxo junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' chi' t'a wichanh ichataxon t'a sleyal yuj smul jun anima ix och chi', ayik toxo ix ak'chaj jun silab' chi', stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yib'anh.
Hanheja' jun ley chi' tz'och yopisio eyuuj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, ayik tz'och he mul to manh sk'anok he k'ool.

Palta tato ay mach tz'och smul to sk'an sk'ool, wach'chom eyetchonhab', ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il, a t'ayin Jehová in tik tz'och smul yuj spitalil. Yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik jun anima chi' t'a he kal.
Yujto ix spatikejel in lolonel, ix stenanek' in cheknab'il, yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ayek' heb' israel t'a tzinan lu'um, ay jun winh israel chi' wan yek' k'atzitz t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip ix yilan heb'.
Ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés, t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' yuj heb' ix ilan chi'.
Ix tanhwaj winh yuj heb' yujto manto chekelok tas ol utaj winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik yowalil ol cham winh. Masanil heb' chonhab' tik sjulk'enan winh t'a spatikel kampamento, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'el winh heb' t'a spatikel kampamento chi'. Hata' ix sjulk'enejcham winh heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha ex tik yet' heb' eyinhtilal, yowalilokab' tz'och yelwanub' stitak he pichul. Ha juntzanh yelwanub' tz'och chi', a anh ch'al tzek'b'il topan, stz'ischajoch t'a he pichul chi' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak.

Ayik ol eyilanoch juntzanh yelwanub' chi', ol he naankot masanil cheknab'il ix wala' to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej, yik wach' manh ol ex kuchb'ajb'at t'a juntzanh tas malaj swach'il yuj he pensar, ma yuj tas he gana t'a yol eyiko'.
Icha wal chi' ol aj he naankot in cheknab'il, ol he k'anab'ajani. Icha chi' ol aj eyak'anoch he b'a t'ayin to wik ex, a in he Diosal in.
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosalok, yuj chi' swal juntzanh tik t'ayex, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha winhaj Coré yuninal winhaj Izhar yinhtilalkan winhaj Koat, t'a yinhtilal Leví yet' oxwanhxo heb' t'a yinhtilal Rubén, haton winhaj Datán, winhaj Abiram yuninal heb' winhaj Eliab yet' pax winhaj On yuninal winhaj Pelet, ix meltzajoch heb' winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Moisés. Ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' winh smolb'an 250-xo heb' yetisraelal. Ha heb' winh ix yak'och sb'a chi', yajalil chonhab' yaj heb' winh, ayoch heb' winh sb'isulok heb' winh tz'ak'an slajtial junok lolonel t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Masanil heb' winh chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a, ix b'at heb' winh yil winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --k'okb'ilxo eyik'anchaanh he b'a, yujto ko masanil onh a onh tik, yikxo Jehová kaji, aypaxek' t'a ko kal ko masanil. ¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och he b'a yajalil t'a kib'anh a onh schonhab' onh Jehová tik? xchi heb' winh.
Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Coré yet' t'a masanil heb' winh tzak'anoch yuj winh chi' icha tik: --Hato k'ik'an sch'ox Jehová t'ayonh mach heb' yiko'. Anhej heb' sik'b'ilel yuj ol yal yoch t'a stz'ey yak'an serwil t'a altar.

Ha t'a q'uinhib'alil k'ik'an, tzeyik'kot he chaynub' yik inkienso, tzeyak'anem tzak'ak' t'a yool yet' inkienso, tzeyak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha mach sik'kanel Jehová chi', haton jun chi' sik'b'iltaxonel yuj. k'okb'ilxo eyik'anchaanh he b'a a ex ex wetlewitail tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Coré chi' icha tik: --Ha ex ex wetlewitail tik, ab'ek tas ol wala':
¿Tom te jab'nhej yelk'och jun tik he naani, sik'b'il ex el yuj ko Diosal t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', ix ex yak'anoch t'a slak'anil yik tze tanhwej skajnub' yet' eyak'an serwil heb' eyetchonhab'?
Ix el t'a sk'ool Jehová to tzex och t'a slak'anil, haxo tiknaik he gana tzex ochxonhej sakerdoteal.

Wal yel a winhaj Aarón malaj yelk'och winh, ¿tas yuj tzeyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik winh yet' masanil heb' ajun eyet' tik? Ha t'a Jehová chuk tzex loloni ayik tzeyalan chuk t'a spatik winhaj Aarón chi', xchi winh.
T'a elanhchamel ix schek winhaj Moisés chi' b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram yuninal winhaj Eliab, palta ix yalankot heb' winh chi' icha tik: --Max onh b'atlaj.
¿Tom jab'nhej tas tzonh utej? Ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj te wach', manh jantakok tas ay t'a sat lu'um, ix onh ik'ankoti yik tzonh cham t'a tik. Ha gana to tzak'och a b'a yajalil t'a tik.

Ha ach tik manhok t'a junok lum lum te ay tas t'a sat b'aj ix onh ik'koti, malaj jab'ok ko lu'um tzak'a yik skawej jab'ok ko uwa. ¿Tom te kistal onh tzila'? Aktejxo onh ak'an musansatil. Manh ol onh b'atlaj kab' tas tzal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ix te kot yowal winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --Manh a cha yofrenda heb' winh chi'. Ha in tik, te malaj tas swutej heb' winh, malaj junok sb'uru heb' winh swik'eq'ui, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Coré chi' icha tik: --Ha ach tik a k'ik'an tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová yet' heb' winh 250 ajun het'ok. Hanheja' pax winhaj Aarón, sk'ochpax winh ta'.

Ha ach tik yet' winhaj Aarón chi', tzeyik'b'at he chaynub' yik inkienso, tzeyak'anem inkienso t'a yool. Hanheja' icha chi' syutejpax heb' winh ajun heyet'ok tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi', ix yik'ankot schaynub' heb' winh chi', ix yak'anem tzak'ak' heb' winh t'a yool yet' inkienso. Ix smolb'anoch sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a sti' kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.

Ha winhaj Coré chi' toxo ix smolb'ejoch heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi' t'a sti' skajnub' Dios, haton heb' winh ayxo och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix sch'oxan stzikikial Jehová t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
