--B'esekel he b'a t'a skal juntzanh anima tik. T'a jun rato tik ol in satel heb', xchi.
Yuj chi' ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin, yajal aj t'a sk'inal masanil anima, ¿tom tza satel masanil heb' anima tik yuj smul junok? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Ha tiknaik al t'a masanil heb' molanek' tik to sb'esel sb'a heb' smasanil t'a spatiktak smantiado winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e waan winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi', ix b'at masanil heb' yichamtak winakil heb' israel yet' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --B'esekel he b'a t'a smantiado jun makan heb' anima chuk spensar tik. Malaj junok tas ay t'a heb' tzeyama', tato maay, ol ex cham yuj syaelal smul heb', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sb'esel sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a spatiktak smantiado winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi'. Ha winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi', ix elta linhan heb' winh t'a sti' smantiado yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal.
Ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan icha tik: --Icha tik ol aj eyojtakkaneli to a Jehová schekan in k'ulej masanil juntzanh tik, manh yolok wik tzin k'ulej.
Tato ilya tz'ik'an scham heb' tik, ichataxon tz'aj scham anima, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová tzin ak'anoch t'a jun opisio tik.

Palta tato ay junok tas to mantalaj b'aj tzuji ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol spoj sb'a lum lum tik, haxo heb' anima tik pitzanto heb' ol b'atkan heb' t'a yol lu'um yet' masanil tas ay t'ay. Tato icha chi' ol aj scham heb', ol eyojtakejeli to ix spatikejel Jehová heb', xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix pax lewnaj lum lum t'a yalanh heb' winh chi'.
Ix emkan heb' winh t'a yol lu'um yet' yalyuninal smasanil. Icha wal chi' ix aj satel masanil heb' junnhej ix aj spensar yet' winhaj Coré chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.

Pitzan heb' anima chi' smasanil ix b'atkan heb' t'a yol lu'um chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix snub'anxi sb'a lu'um. Icha chi' ix aj satkanel jun makan anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima oyanek' t'a spatiktak chi', ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yalan heb': Mokab' b'atpax lewnaj lum t'a kalanh a onh tik, xchi heb'.
Hanheja' ix yak'paxkot k'ak' Jehová yik ix tz'apaxb'at heb' 250 ix nhusan inkienso, haton heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al t'a winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Aarón to syik'elta juntzanh schaynub' yik inkienso heb' winh ix tz'ab'at chi' winh, haton juntzanh nab'a bronke. Slajwi chi' najat sb'at winh stob'kanel tzak'ak' ayem t'a yool.

Ha schaynub' yik inkienso juntzanh anima ix cham yuj smul tik, wikxo ix ajkani, yujto ix k'anchaji a ix yak'an inkienso heb' t'ayin. Yuj chi', a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' tze b'ooch t'a laminail yik tz'och smusilok altar, yik wach' ayik syilanoch heb' israel, snaankot heb' tas ix aj scham heb' yuj schukal, xchi Jehová.

Ix smolb'ankot masanil chaynub' yik inkienso nab'a bronke winhaj sakerdote Eleazar chi', haton juntzanh ix sk'an heb' ix tz'ab'at yuj k'ak' chi', ix yalan winh to tz'ak'ji ulaxok, sb'oji t'a laminail yik tz'och smusilok altar.

Ha jun tik ix kani yik snaankot heb' israel yet' yojtakanel heb' to anhej heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón syal yoch t'a yichanh altar yik snhusan inkienso heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Tato ay junokxo komonnhej sk'ulej icha chi', scham icha ix aj scham winhaj Coré yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winhaj Moisés, icha chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, masanil heb' israel ix och ijan yawaj chaanh t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik, ix he milcham heb' schonhab' Jehová, xchi heb'.

Ayik wan smolb'an sb'a heb' chonhab' smasanil t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi', ix b'at k'elan heb' t'a skajnub' Dios. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix och moynaj asun t'a skajnub' chi', ix sch'oxan stzikikial Jehová.
Yuj chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh kajnub' chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Elanhek t'a stz'ey juntzanh anima tik, yujto ha t'a jun rato tik ol in satel heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi. Ixnhej wal yab' heb' winh icha chi', ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot a chaynub' yik inkienso, tzak'an b'ut'jok yet' tzak'ak' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Tzak'anpaxem inkienso t'a yool, tzach b'at t'a skal heb' anima t'a elanhchamel. Tza k'anan niwank'olal yuj smul heb', yujto toxo ix kot yowal Jehová. Toxo ix ja ilya yik scham anima smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón chi', elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a skal heb' anima b'aj ayek' molan chi'. Ha yuj jun ilya ix yak'kot Jehová chi' toxo ix yamchajoch scham anima. T'a wal jun rato chi', ix yak'anem inkienso winh yik tz'ak'ji niwank'olal heb' anima chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix och winh t'a skal heb' anima toxo ix chami yet' heb' pitzanto. Ichato chi' ix och waan jun ilya chi'.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', 14 mil 700 heb' anima ix chami. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanh heb' toxo ix cham yet' winhaj Coré yuj schukal.
Hato yik ix och waan scham anima chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Aarón b'aj ayek' winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' winh yajalil chonhab' t'a junjun inhtilal to syik'kot junjunok sk'okoch heb' winh, syalelk'ochi to lajchawe' te' skot t'a smasanil, tz'och sb'i junjun heb' winh t'a te' sk'okoch chi'.
Ha te' yik yinhtilal Leví, a sb'i winhaj Aarón tz'och t'a te', yujto junjun sk'okoch heb' winh yajalil junjun inhtilal ol kotok.
Tzak'kanoch te' t'a yichanh skaxail trato ay t'a yol in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Hata' ol wak' wolan sk'okoch mach syal in k'ool to ol in sik'kaneli, yuj chi' ol och waan heb' anima tik yalan he pekal, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' winh yajalil chonhab' t'a junjun inhtilal. Ix yak'an sk'okoch junjun heb' winh t'a winh, lajchawe' te' t'a smasanil. Aypaxoch te' yik winhaj Aarón chi' t'a skal te'.
Ix yak'anoch te' k'okoch chi' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yol kajnub' yik trato.
Haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil ix k'och winh ta', ix yilanoch te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón chi' winh t'a yik yinhtilal Leví, toxo ix elta swol te', ayxo xumakil yet' pax sat, q'uinhxo te' almendro chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta te' k'okoch chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ix sch'oxan te' winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal. Haxo ix lajwi yilan te' heb', ix yak'anxi junjun te' yik heb' winh chi' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: Ak'kanoch te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh skaxail trato. Sik'kanb'at te' ta' yik snakot juntzanh anima te pit tik. Yuj chi' ol yaktej heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'ayin yik max cham heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés sk'ulan masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Haxo ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' t'a winh icha tik: Junelnhej chamnak onhxo el ko masanil.
Tato jichan scham masanil heb' snitzkot sb'a t'a skajnub' Jehová, ol onh cham ko masanil syal chi', xchi heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik: Tato tz'och junok palta t'a in kajnub', a yaelal sja yuj jun chi', ha t'a ib'anh yet' heb' uninal yet' t'a yib'anh heb' etlewitail sjawi. Palta a junok paltail t'a eyopisio t'a sakerdoteal, anhej t'a ib'anh yet' heb' uninal sjawi yaelal yuj jun chi'.
Tzik'kot heb' etlewitail yik skolwaj heb' het'ok ayik ayachoch yet' heb' uninal t'a eyopisio t'a yol in kajnub' yik trato.

Haton heb' smunlaj het'ok t'a in kajnub' chi', palta chekelnhej yaj yopisio heb'. Max yal-laj sjawi heb' t'a slak'anil altar, max yalpaxlaj syaman syamk'ab'il in kajnub' chi' heb' yik wach' max cham heb' yet' ex pax tik.
Ajun heb' smunlaj heyet'ok, palta a ex tzeyala' tas sk'ulej heb' ayik sb'oan masanil smunlajel heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Malaj junokxo komon anima syal sja t'a he lak'anil.
Ha exnhej tik ayoch t'a eyib'anh he b'oan masanil munlajel t'a in kajnub' yet' t'a altar yik manhxo ol kot wowal t'a masanil heb' etchonhab'.
Ha in ix wik'kanel heb' etlewitail t'a skal masanil heb' etisraelal. Ix wak'an heb' t'ayex yik smunlaj heb' heyet'ok t'a in kajnub'.

Palta a achnhej yet' heb' uninal tzil munlajel b'aj ay altar yet' t'a spatikoch k'apak kortina. Ha juntzanh opisio chi' ix wala' to a exnhej tik tzeyila', yujto a in ix wak' eyopisio. Tato ay junok mach manh ayokoch sakerdoteal t'a yib'anh snitzanoch sb'a t'a slak'anil juntzanh yamk'ab' chi', a jun chi' tojolnhej schami, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: Ha in swak' opisio a chaan masanil juntzanh ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj heb' etisraelal tik. Masanil tas syik'kot heb' chi' t'ayin, ik tz'ajkan yet' heb' uninal. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Masanil ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ayin, a in swak' t'ayach yet' t'a heb' uninal, haton juntzanh max tz'alaj: Ofrenda yik ixim trigo, silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul yet' silab' yuj stupchaj mul.
Masanil heb' winak t'a he kal tik, syal schi'an juntzanh silab' chi' heb', anhej t'a junok lugar wik yaji, hata' schi heb'. Yowalil tze na'a to wik yaj juntzanh silab' chi'.

Swak'pax t'ayach yet' t'a ix etb'eyum yet' t'a heb' uninal juntzanh ofrenda syik'kot heb' etisraelal t'ayin, haton juntzanh sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh. Ha jun ley tik skan t'a masanil tiempo, yalnhej mach heb' ayek' kajan heyet'ok to wach' yaj icha yalan ley, syalnhej schi'an heb'.
Ha sb'ab'el sat tastak tz'awchaji haton syik'kot heb' etisraelal t'ayin t'a junjun ab'il, swak'kanpax t'ayach: Haton akeite te wach', wino te wach' yet' ixim trigo te wach',
yet' pax sb'ab'el sat masanil te' awb'en te' syik'kot heb' t'ayin. Ha juntzanh chi' ik yaj yet' masanil heb' ayek' kajan het'ok. Tato wach' yaj heb' icha yalan ley, syal swaan heb'.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' etisraelal t'ayin, iknhej yaji.

Masanil heb' sb'ab'el winak unin heb' etisraelal yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' syak' t'ayin, iknhejpax yaji. Palta a yuj heb' b'ab'el winak unin chi' yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' nok' max ochtaxon silab'il, yowalil tz'ak'ji k'een tumin sk'exulok.
Ayik junxo ujal yalji, tz'ak'ji k'een tumin chi' sk'exulok. Ha yuj heb' unin chi', oye' siklo k'een plata tz'ak'ji, icha k'een sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', 20 geras yalil.

Palta manh a cha ak'jok tumin sk'exulok sb'ab'el yune' nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa, yujto a juntzanh nok' chi', wik yaj nok'. Yowalil tze milcham nok', tze tzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a altar, haxo xepual nok' tze nhustz'aok yik tz'och t'a ofrendail to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i.
Ik tz'ajkan masanil schib'ejal nok' chi', icha ix aj wak'an schib'ejal juntzanhxo nok' silab' t'ayach, haton nok' snhi' sk'ool sb'akhchajk'e t'a yichanh altar yet' sb'ak'chil xub' nok' t'a swach'.

Masanil yofrenda heb' etisraelal syik'eli to wik yaji, swak' t'ayach yet' t'a ix etb'eyum yet' t'a heb' uninal. Ha jun tik, ley tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo, a in tzin b'okan heyet'ok yet' masanil eyinhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Ha ach tik malaj lum lum ol a makb'enej t'a skal heb' etisraelal tik, yujto a in tik icha a makb'en waji.
Ha heb' lewita, a masanil sdiezmoal sat yawb'en heb' eyetisraelal, a ix wak' smakb'enej heb'. Haton ayoch stojolok masanil smunlajel heb' t'a kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Haxo masanil juntzanhxo heb' etisraelal, max yal komonnhej sjawi heb' t'a slak'anil kajnub' chi'. Tato icha chi' sk'ulej heb', tz'ochkan chamel t'a yib'anh heb' yuj smul chi'.

Yuj chi' anhej heb' lewita ay yalan yik yilan masanil tas yik in kajnub' chi'. Tato tz'och junok spaltail heb' t'a smunlajel chi', anhej t'a yib'anh heb' skotkan yaelal. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' lewita malaj slum heb' ol scha t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal.
Yik heb' yaj masanil sdiezmoal tas syawej heb' eyetisraelal syak' t'ayin a in Jehová in tik. Yuj chi' ix wala' to malaj slum heb' ol scha'a, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:

Al t'a masanil heb' lewita to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ayik ol he chaan masanil sdiezmo heb' eyetisraelal, yowalil tzeyik'paxkanel sdiezmoal yik tzeyak'an t'ayin, yujto a juntzanh chi' ayoch he makb'enok.
Ha jun diezmo tzeyak' chi', icha sdiezmoal sat smunlajel heb' eyetisraelal syak'a'.
Ha t'a diezmo tze cha t'a heb' eyetisraelal chi', hata' tzeyik'paxel eyofrenda tzeyak' t'ayin. Ha t'a winhaj sakerdote Aarón tzeyak'a'.
Yuj chi' masanil tastak tz'ak'ji t'ayex, yowalil tzeyik'kanel junok makan t'ay, tzeyak'an t'ayin. Ha jun makan tzeyak' t'ayin chi', yowalil haton wal swach'il.
Ayik toxo ix eyik'kanel swach'il to wik yaj chi', haxo jantakto skani, eyikxo tz'ajkani ichato a ex ay he munlajel.
Syalxo he waan yet' eyal eyuninal yalxonhej b'aj kajan ex. E tojol yaj yuj b'aj tzex munlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ayik toxo ix eyik'kanel jun makan te wach' chi' t'ayin, tzaxo yal he waan jantakto skan chi', malaj he mul tz'och yuj he waani. Ha t'a icha chi', max eyixtejb'atlaj yofrenda heb' eyetisraelal to wik yaji. Yuj chi' maxtzak jawilaj chamel t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in swak' jun cheknab'il tik. Alek t'a heb' eyetchonhab' to syik'kot junok nok' kob'es chakchak wakax heb' malaj jab'ok spaltail, manto junelok smunlaji.
Ha ex tik tzeyak' nok' t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar. Tz'ik'jiel nok' t'a spatikel kampamento, haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' schekan miljokcham nok' t'a yichanh.
Syik'ank'e schiq'uil nok' winh yet' yiximal sk'ab', stzikanb'at ukelok winh t'a stojolal in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Slajwi chi', snhusjitz'a nok' wakax chi' smasanil t'a yichanh winh, stz'umal nok', sb'ak'chil nok', schiq'uil nok' yet' yol sk'ool nok'.
Yakb'an wan stz'a nok' chi' syik'anpaxk'e te' k'ute' winh sakerdote chi' yet' junok sk'ab' te' hisopo yet' nok' chakchak lana, syak'anoch winh smasanil t'a yol k'ak' b'aj wan stz'a nok' chi'.
Slajwi chi, sjuk'anel spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, tz'ochxi winh t'a yol kampamento chi', wach'chom manto wach'ok yaj winh icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil.
Haxo winh ix nhusantz'a nok' wakax chi', sjuk'paxel spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, palta manto wach'ok yaj winh icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil.

Haxo junokxo winh winak wach' yaj icha yalan ley, ha' winh smolank'e staanhil nok' wakax chi', sik'anb'at winh t'a junok lugar to wach' yaj t'a spatikel kampamento. Ha juntzanh taanh chi' sk'an heb' eyetisraelal ayik sb'oan ha ha' heb' sk'anchaji yik sakb'itaj heb' icha yalan ley. Masanil juntzanh tik sk'ulaji yik syik'anel mul.

Ha mach ix molank'e juntzanh taanh chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manto wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil. Ha jun ley tik skannhej t'a junelnhej, tz'och yopisio eyuuj a ex israel ex tik yet' yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.
Ha mach syaman sniwanil junok chamnak, manh wach'ok yaj t'a uke' k'ual icha yalan ley.

Ha t'a schab'jial syaman junok chamnak chi' yet' t'a swak'jial, yowalil sakb'itej sb'a yet' ha ha' sk'anchaji yik sakb'i icha yalan ley, ichato chi' wach' tz'ajkani. Tato max sakb'itej sb'a t'a schab'jial yet' t'a swak'jial, manto wach'ok syal chi'.

Yuj chi' a junok mach syaman junok chamnak, tato max sakb'itej sb'a, a jun chi' syixtejel in kajnub'. Yuj chi' yowalil manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, yujto maj tzikjioch ha ha' chi' t'ay, yuj chi' manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley.
Haton juntzanh sleyal tik t'a junok mach scham b'aj ay skajnub': Yalnhej mach tz'och ta', ma junok ayek' ta', manh wach'ok tz'ajkan t'a uke' k'ual.
Masanil chen to manh wach'ok yaj smakji, manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Haxo mach syaman junok chamnak t'a stiel chonhab', taxonhej mak'b'ilchamok, ma tonhej scham ichataxon tz'aj scham anima, mato syam sb'akil junok chamnak, ma junok b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, a jun chi' manh wach'ok yaj t'a uke' k'ual.
Ha yuj masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ik'chajk'e jab'ok staanhil nok' wakax tz'anak yuj yik'anel mul, tz'ak'chajem t'a yol junok yet'tal, tz'ak'jiem ha ha' t'a yib'anh, haton ha' sk'eul sjaj.

Haxo junok winh winak wach' yaj icha yalan ley, a winh tz'ik'ank'e junok sk'ab' te' hisopo, slab'anem winh t'a skal ha ha' chi', stzikanoch winh t'a yib'anh jun kajnub' chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a yool yet' t'a yib'anh heb' anima ayek' ta', hanhejtona' stzikanpaxb'at winh t'a yib'anh mach ix yaman sb'akil chamnak, ma junok b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak chi', ma sniwanil junok anima mak'b'ilchamok, ma junok tonhej ix cham ichataxon tz'aj scham anima.

Ha jun anima wach' yaj chi', ha' stzikanb'at ha ha' chi' t'a yib'anh heb' manh wach'ok yaj chi' t'a schab'jial yet' t'a swak'jial. Slajwi chi', ha t'a swak'jial chi', sjuk'anel spichul heb', sb'ikanpaxel sb'a heb' yik sakb'ikan heb'. Icha chi' wach'xo tz'ajkan heb' t'a yemk'ualil.

Tato ay junok anima max sakb'itej sb'a icha yalan ley, manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej yujto syixtejb'at in kajnub'. Yujto maj tzikjioch ha ha' t'ay yik sakb'i, yuj chi' manh wach'oknhej yaji.
Ha jun ley tik skannhej t'a junelnhej: Ha mach stzikanoch ha ha' chi' t'a junokxo, yowalil sjuk'el spichul. Ha mach syaman ha ha' tz'ak'an sakb'ok junok mach chi', wach'xo tz'ajkan t'a yemk'ualil.
Masanil mach syamji yuj junok anima manh wach'ok yaji, ma junok syaman junok anima manh wach'ok yaji, a jun chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil, xchi Jehová.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj, ix k'och heb' israel t'a tzinan lu'um skuch Zin. Ix aj heb' jun pekti' t'a yol yik Cades. Hata' ix cham ix María yanab' winhaj Moisés, ix mukchajkanem ix ta'.
Yujto te malaj ha ha' syuk' heb' israel chi', yuj chi' ix k'e yaw heb' smasanil t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Oktom onh chamkan yet' heb' ketchonhab' ix chamkan yuj Jehová.
¿Tas yuj ix onh eyik'kot t'a takinh lu'um tik? ¿Tom he gana tzonh champax a onh tik yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok'?

¿Tas yuj ix onh eyik'elta t'a yol yik Egipto, ix onh eyik'ankot t'a jun lugar manhxo jantakok schukal tik? Ha t'a tik max yak'laj ixim trigo, te' higo, te' uwa, te' granado, malaj pax jab'ok ha ha' syal kuk'ani, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi', ix snitzanel sb'a heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh t'a sti' skajnub' Jehová. Hata' ix b'at em nhojan heb' winh t'a sat lu'um. Haxo t'a jun rato chi' ix sch'ox sb'a stzikikial Jehová t'a slak'anil heb' winh.
Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

--Ik'b'at te' a k'okoch, tzalan t'a winh uk'tak aj Aarón chi' to tz'och winh het'ok yik tze molanb'at heb' anima, tzex b'at b'aj ay jun k'een niwan tenam. T'a yichanh heb' tzal t'a k'een to tz'elta ha ha' t'a sat k'een, haxo t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima chi' ol elul ha', ol yuk'an ha' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yik'anelta te k'okoch winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh Jehová icha ix aj yalani.

Ix smolb'anb'at heb' anima chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh k'een tenam chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Ab'ek, a ex to te pit ex tik: ¿Yowalil am wal skik'elta ha ha' t'a sat k'een tenam tik, skak'an ha' eyuk'ej? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yalan winh icha chi', ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh, ix spajanoch chael te' sk'okoch winh t'a sat k'een tenam chi', ix elul chulnaj ha ha' chi'. Ix yuk'an ha' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: --Yujto a ex tik max in eyak' wal och t'a he k'ool, maj he ch'ox t'a yichanh heb' eyetchonhab' tik to Ha inxonhej Ochi, yuj chi' manhok exlaj ol eyik'och heb' anima tik t'a sat lum lum chi' b'aj ix wala' to ol wak' t'ayex, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Meriba ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi', yujto hata' ix yalub'tanhej heb' israel t'a spatik Jehová. Ix sch'oxan Jehová chi' to Haxonhej Ochi.

Ayik ayek' winhaj Moisés t'a Cades, ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh winak winh t'a winh sreyal Edom yik b'at yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha onh israel onh tik, ayto kuj ko b'a het'ok, skalb'at t'ayach: Ojtak jantak syail ix kil t'a Egipto.
Hanhejtona' ojtakpaxi tas aj sk'ochnakkan heb' ko mam kicham ta' t'a peka'. Haxo t'a slajwub'alxo tik, ix yak' wal och yaelal heb' winh aj Egipto chi' t'a yib'anh heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'a kib'anh.
Yuj chi' ix ko k'an skolwal Jehová ket'ok. Ix yab' yel kaw, yuj chi' ix yak'ankot yángel yik ix onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto chi'. Ha tiknaik ayonh ek' t'a chonhab' Cades b'aj ay smojonal a makb'en.

Yuj chi' skal t'ayach, tope wal tz'el t'a a k'ool tzonh a chaek' t'a yol a makb'en tik. Manh ol onh ek'laj t'a skal yawb'en heb' anima ay t'a yol a makb'en tik. Malaj ha ha' t'a eyuk'b'il ha' ol kuk'ej. Anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh b'atok. Malaj b'aj ol onh el b'esnaj t'a yol niwan b'e chi' masanto ol onh k'axpajek' t'a yol a nakión tik, xchib'at winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Edom chi' icha tik: --Manh ex k'axpajek' t'a yol in nakión tik. Tato ol ex ek' t'a yib'anh, ol ex k'axpajek'ok, ol in elb'at t'a he patik yet' heb' in soldado, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalanpax heb' israel chi' icha tik: --Maay, a onh tik anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh b'atok. Tato ay b'aj ol kuk'ej ha ha' yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' t'a eyuk'lab'a, ol ko tup t'ayach. Anhej wal to ko gana tzonh k'axpajek' t'a a lugar tik t'a wach'il, xchib'at heb'.

Ix tak'wixi winh sreyal Edom chi' icha tik: --Malaj permiso he k'axpajeq'ui, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' soldado smak heb' israel chi'. Yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' soldado chi' yik owal, te tek'anpax heb'.
Yuj chi' ix say junxo b'e heb' israel b'aj ix b'ati.
Masanil heb' israel ix el heb' t'a Cades, ix kot heb' t'a stojolal lum witzal Hor t'a sat smojonal Edom.
Hata' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yuj winhaj Aarón icha tik:

Ha tiknaik, toxo ol cham winhaj Aarón, manh ol k'ochlaj winh t'a sat lum ix wala' to ol wak' t'ayex, yujto a ex tik he chawanhil ix he pitej he b'a t'a in cheknab'il ix wak' t'ayex t'a sti' ha' Meriba.
Ha tiknaik, ik'b'at winhaj Aarón chi' yet' winh yuninal skuch Eleazar t'a jolom witz Hor chi'.
Hata' ol ik'el spichul winhaj Aarón chi' sk'an t'a sakerdoteal, tzak'ankanoch t'a winhaj Eleazar chi', yujto a winhaj Aarón chi' ol cham winh ta', xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés tas ix yal Jehová chi', t'a wal yichanh masanil anima ix ik'jib'at winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' yuj winh t'a jolom witz Hor chi'.

Hata' ix yik'el spichul winhaj Aarón chi' winh, ix yak'anoch winh t'a winhaj Eleazar t'a jolom witz chi'. Hata' ix chamkan winhaj Aarón chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Haxo ix yab'an masanil heb' israel to toxo ix cham winhaj Aarón chi', jun ujal ix och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winh sreyal heb' kananeo ay t'a Arad t'a yol yik Neguev to wan skot heb' israel t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a Atarim, ix elta winh yak' owal yet' heb'. Ay heb' ix yamchaj yuj winh ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a preso.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sti' heb' israel t'a Jehová, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tato ol ach kolwaj ket'ok yik skak'an ganar jun nakión chi', ol ko satkanel junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en chi' t'a junelnhej, xchi heb'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová skolwaj icha ix aj sk'anan heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb' kananeo chi' heb'. Ix satkanel heb' kananeo chi' smasanil yet' schonhab'il, yuj chi' Horma ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'.

Ix el heb' israel t'a yich witz Hor chi', ix ek' heb' t'a b'e tzek' t'a ha' Chakchak Mar. Najat ix ek' yoy sb'a heb' yujto maj k'axpajek' heb' t'a lum Edom. Ayik ayoch heb' t'a yol b'e chi', ix chab'axk'e sk'ool heb',

ix kot yowal heb' t'a Dios yet' t'a winhaj Moisés. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto? ¿Tom yuj ko cham yuj wejel t'a takinh lu'um tik? Malaj tas sko wa''a, malaj pax tas skuk'ej. Maxtzak techaj ko waan juntzanh chukal wael tik, xchi heb'.
Yuj wal chi' ix ak'jikot juntzanh nok' chan te ow yuj Jehová, yik schiji heb' anima chi' yuj nok'. Tzijtum heb' israel chi' ix cham yuj nok'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' icha chi', ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix och ko mul a onh tik, ix kal chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yet' t'ayach. Ha tiknaik k'an t'a Jehová to syik'el nok' chan tik t'a ko kal, xchi heb'. Ix sk'anan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová to syak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh heb' anima chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --B'o junok yechel chan t'a k'een bronke icha yilji juntzanh nok' chi', tzak'ank'e t'a schon junok te te' chaanh steel, yik wach' ayik schiji heb' anima yuj nok' chan chi', tato sk'e k'elan heb' t'a jun yechel chan chi', maxtzak chamlaj heb' yuj nok', xchi t'a winh.

Ix sb'oan jun yechel chan nab'a bronke winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'ank'e winh t'a schon jun te te'. Yuj chi' yalnhej mach schiji yuj nok' chan chi', sk'e k'elan heb' t'a jun yechel chan chi', sb'oxikan heb'.
Ix b'eynhejkot heb' israel, ix jawi heb' t'a Obot.
Ix elpax heb' t'a Obot chi', ix b'eynhejkot heb' t'a yichanh, ix jawi heb' t'a Ije-abarim t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yol yik Moab.
Ix kotnhej heb', ix jawi heb' t'a jun ha' eluma' skuch Zered.

Ix b'eynhejkot heb', ix jawi heb' t'a sk'axepalb'at jun ha ha' skuch Arnón. Ha jun ha ha' chi' tzek' t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik heb' amorreo. Haton jun ha' chi' ayoch mojonal yuj heb' Moab yet' heb' amorreo chi'.
Haton juntzanh lugar chi' sb'inaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal owal yik Jehová, b'aj syal icha tik: Onh ek'ta t'a chonhab' Waheb t'a yol yik Sufá, t'a yoltak ha' Arnón.
Ha jun pak'an t'a stitak ha ha' chi' ayoch smojonalok yik Moab, sk'och t'a chonhab' Ar, xchi.

Ix el heb' t'a ha' Arnón chi', ix kotnhej heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a Beer. Haton ta' ay jun ha' uk'b'ila' b'aj ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik: Molb'ej masanil anima, a in ol wak' ha ha' yuk'ej heb', xchi t'a winh.
Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' ix b'itan heb' israel icha tik: Ix k'eul ha ha' b'aj molan. Q'ueokab'kot b'urnaj ha ha'. To ol onh b'itanek yuj ha ha' ix k'eul b'urnaj tik.

Ha heb' winh yajal ix joyank'eta ha' yet' sk'okoch. Ha heb' winh niwak yajal t'a yol schonhab', a yet' sk'okoch heb' winh ix sjakk'eta ha ha', xchi heb' t'a sb'it chi'. Ix b'eynhejkot heb' t'a tzinan lu'um masanto ix jawi heb' t'a Matana.
Ix el heb' t'a Matana chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Nahaliel. Ix el heb' t'a Nahaliel chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Bamot.
Ix el heb' t'a Bamot chi', ix jawi heb' t'a jun ch'olan ay t'a yol yik Moab, t'a stojolal lum niwak witz t'a yol yik Pisga, haton ta' niwan chekel lum tzinan lu'um.
Ix yak'b'at schekab' heb' israel t'a winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, ix yalanb'at heb' icha tik:

¿Tom max onh a chaek' t'a yol a makb'en? Malaj jab'ok tas ol ek' ko lob'at t'a skal eyawb'en yet' t'a skal eyuwa, manh ol kuk' ha ha' t'a eyuk'b'il ha', anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh ek'ok, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Maj scha sk'ol winhaj Sehón chi' yek' heb' israel t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Anhej to ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh, ix elta winh yak' owal yet' heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a Jahaza ix yak' owal heb'.

Ix yak'an owal heb' israel chi' yet' heb', ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Sehón yet' heb' soldado yuj heb'. Ix ik'jiek' lum sluum heb' chi' yuj heb' israel chi'. Sb'atnhej t'a sti' ha' Arnón, masanto sk'och t'a sti' ha' Jaboc, masanto b'aj tzek' smojonal sluum heb' amonita. Ha jun lu'um chi' te wach' yaj smakchaj yuj heb' amonita chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yochkan slum heb' amorreo yikok heb' israel chi'. Ix kajnaj heb' israel t'a chonhab' Hesbón yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a spatiktak.

Ha Hesbón chi', haton jun chonhab' b'aj ek'nak winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo. Ha winhaj Sehón chi' ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' heb' winh sreyal Moab t'a yalanhtaxo. Ix ik'jiek' jun makan slum heb' yuj winh sk'ochnhej t'a ha' Arnón.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' slolon t'a poesía icha tik: Kotanhek t'a Hesbón, haton t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Sehón. B'oekxik'e t'a schaelal, wach' tzeyutej he b'oanoch smuroal.
Hato t'a Hesbón, t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Sehón ix kot heb' ix nhusantz'a chonhab' Ar t'a yol yik Moab yet' heb' niwak yajal yaj t'a jun chonhab' t'a pak'an t'a yib'anhk'e ha' Arnón.

Ex aj Moab, ob'iltak ex. Toxo ix ex lajwiel ex schonhab' Dios Quemos. Haton jun he diosal chi' maj yal-laj skolwaji, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' soldado smasanil, haxonhej heb' ix ix, ix kan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey Sehón.
Toxo ix lajwiel yipalil chonhab' Hesbón. Ix satel heb' ay t'a chonhab' Dibón masanto ix satel heb' ay t'a Nofa yet' pax Medeba, xchi jun poesía chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankan lum lum heb' israel makb'il yuj heb' amorreo.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at schekab' winhaj Moisés t'a chonhab' Jazer yik sb'eytzitej heb' tas yaji. Ix ak'ji ganar jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb' israel yet' masanil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatiktak. Ix pechjiel masanil heb' kajan ta' yuj heb', haton heb' amorreo.
Ix meltzaj heb', ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal lum Basán, palta ix elta winhaj Og sreyal Basán chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' t'a Edrei.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Manh ex xiw t'a winhaj Og chi', a in ol wak'och winh yet' heb' soldado yet' smakb'en tik t'a yol he k'ab'. Icha ix eyutej winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo ay t'a Hesbón, icha chi' ol eyutejpax winhaj Og tik, xchi t'a winh.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Og yet' yuninal yet' masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' israel, manhxo junok heb' ix kani. Ix ochkan sluum heb' yikok heb' israel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'eynhejkot heb' israel chi', ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a lum ak'lik yik Moab t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán t'a satkot Jericó.
Ix yab'an winhaj Balac sreyal Moab yuninal winhaj Zipor, tas ix utaj heb' amorreo yuj heb' israel.
Yuj chi' ix xiwchaanh winh yet' heb' anima ay t'a Moab chi', yujto ix yil winh to te tzijtum heb' israel chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' anima ay t'a Moab chi' t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Madián icha tik: Masanil juntzanh anima tik, ol onh satel heb' t'a ko lu'um tik. Icha tz'aj slajwiel anh ank'ultak yuj nok' wakax, icha chi' ol onh yutok heb', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' to sb'at kot jun winh syaloch sb'a jelanil skuchan Balaam, yuninal winhaj Beor, kajan t'a Petor t'a sti' ha' niwan Éufrates t'a skal heb' yetchonhab'. Ix schekanb'at heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Balac chi', yik sb'at yal heb' t'a winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: Ha t'a Egipto ix kot jun niwan chonhab'il anima, toxo ix majel sat lum lum tik yuj heb', toxo ix jawi heb' t'a ko tz'ey.

Yuj chi' kotanh t'a elanhchamel yik tzul a katab'an heb', yujto yelxo niwan sb'isul heb' t'a kichanh. Tato icha chi' tope ol yal wak'an ganar heb' yik tzin pechanel heb' t'a ko lum tik, yujto wojtak to a a katab' yet' a wach' lolonel tzala', tz'elnhejk'ochi, xchib'at winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Moab yet' heb' yichamtak winakil Madián b'aj ayek' winhaj Balaam chi'. Te niwan k'een tumin ix yik'b'at heb' yik stupan skatab' winh chi' heb'. Ix yalan scheknab'il heb' ix yalb'at winhaj Balac chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Balaam chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, kananhek t'a tik, hato syal tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin t'a jun ak'wal tik, ichato chi' swak'an spak he lolonel chi' k'ik'an, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix kan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' winhaj Balaam chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Ix sch'oxan sb'a Dios t'a winh, ix sk'anb'an t'a winh icha tik: --¿Mach juntzanh anima ayek' chi' t'ayach? xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Chekab' yaj heb' yuj winhaj Balac sreyal Moab yuninal winhaj Zipor, tzul yal heb' t'ayin,

tob' ay jun chonhab'il anima ix kot t'a Egipto. Tob' toxo ix majel sat lum lum yuj heb'. Snib'ej winhaj Balac chi' to tzin b'at t'a schonhab' winh chi', yik sb'at in katab'ej jun chonhab'il anima chi', yik wach' syal spechanel heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi' yalani, xchi winh t'a Dios chi'.
Ix yalan Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh ach b'at yet' heb' yik sb'at a katab'ej jun chonhab'il anima chi', yujto a in wal ix wal wach' lolonel t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.

Haxo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wan winhaj Balaam chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, meltzajanhek t'a he chonhab' yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj in b'at heyet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix meltzaj heb' t'a schonhab' b'aj ay winhaj Balac chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Maj stak'kotlaj sb'a winhaj Balaam chi' ket'ok, xchi heb'.
Maj schalaj yab' winhaj Balac chi', yuj chi' ix chekjib'at juntzanhxo heb' más niwak yopisio t'a yichanh heb' ix xit'ek' chi', ek'topax sb'isul heb' ix b'ati.

Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' yil winhaj Balaam chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Ix onh schekkot winhaj Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor t'ayach, syalan winh t'ayach icha tik: Malajokab' mach tzach kachanoch waan a koti,
yujto ol ach wik' wal chaanh, ol wak'an masanil tas ol a k'ana', anhej to tza k'anab'ajej a kot a katab'ej juntzanh anima tik, xchi winh, xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wipax winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Wach'chom b'ut'jinak yol spalakio winh yuj k'een oro, ma yuj k'een plata, syak'an winh smasanil t'ayin, max yal-laj in k'ulan tas skot t'a in pensar in tenanek' tas syal Jehová in Diosal.
Tato syal he kanpax t'a jun ak'wal tik, ol wab' tas ol yutok Jehová yalanxi t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix sch'oxanpax sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'ak'walil chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Yakb'an to ix jax heb' winh ach yik'b'ati, ixik yet' heb' winh, palta anhej wal tas ol wal t'ayach, anhej b'at ala', xchi t'a winh.
Haxo yik ix q'uinhib'i, ix k'e waan winhaj Balaam chi', ix yak'anoch stz'um nok' snun b'uru winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil Moab chi'.

Ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' sb'uru chi', ix b'at chawanh heb' schekab' winh yet'ok. Haxo Jehová ix kot yowal t'a winh yujto ix b'at winh. Haxo yángel Jehová chi' ix och tek'tek' t'a yol b'e yik smakan b'e chi'.

Haxo ix yilan nok' b'uru chi' to linhanoch jun yángel Jehová t'a nanhal yol b'e, yet'nak jun espada, ix b'atkan nok' t'a kaltak te'. Ix syamanoch winhaj Balaam chi' smak'an nok', yik tz'ochxi nok' t'a yol b'e chi'.
Ix ochxi linhan jun ángel chi' b'aj lot'an b'e t'a skal te' uwa, latz'b'ilk'e k'een k'een smaktealok te' t'a titak b'e chi'.

Haxo ix yilanxi nok' to linhanek' jun ángel chi' t'a nanhal yol b'e chi', ix snhikanek' sb'a nok' t'a k'een k'een ayoch t'a titak b'e chi'. Ix nhikjiek' yok winhaj Balaam chi' yuj nok' t'a k'een, ix ste mak'anxi nok' winh.
Ix el yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix snitzanb'at sb'a t'a yichanhb'ati, ix ochxi linhan b'aj te lot'an b'e, b'aj maxtzak yal yelkan junok mach t'a titak b'e a schalan sb'a yet' junokxo mach.

Ix yilanxi nok' b'uru chi' to linhanek' jun ángel chi' t'a nanhal yol b'e chi', toxonhej ix em lachnaj nok' t'a yalanh winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a nok', ix och ijan winh smak'an nok' yet' sk'okoch.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix lolonk'e nok' yuj Jehová, ix yalan nok' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix ach wutej? Yoxelalxo in a mak'ani, xchi nok'.
--Yujto yelxo wal tzin ixtej swab'i. Ayok wal ek' junok k'een espada t'a tik, wal tiknaik tzach in tekchamok, xchi winh t'a nok'.
Ix tak'wi nok' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in tik a chejintaxoni, tzach k'enhej t'a wib'anh ayik tzach b'eyeq'ui, ojtak to malaj junelok icha tik tzach wutej, xchi nok'. --I' yel toni, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' haxo Jehová ix ak'an yil jun ángel chi' winh, ayek' t'a nanhal yol b'e chi', ayoch k'een espada t'a yol sk'ab'. Ixnhej wal yil jun ángel chi' winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh.
Ix yalan jun ángel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj oxel ix a mak' nok' a b'uru tik? Ha in ix in och t'a ichanh ix in makan a b'e, yujto ix kot wowal yujto ix ach kot yet' juntzanh anima tik.

Anhej nok' b'uru tik ix in hilani, oxel ix elkan nok' t'a yol b'e. Tato maj sb'esel sb'a nok' t'a yol b'e chi', toxom ix ach cham wuj tiknaik, a pax nok' b'uru tik maj am chamlaj nok', xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a yángel Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ix och in mul t'ayach, manh wojtakok tato a ach tza mak in b'e tik, yuj chi' tato max scha a k'ol tzin b'ati, syal in meltzaji, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi jun ángel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Syal a b'at yet' heb' anima tik, palta anhej wal tas ol wal t'ayach, anhej ol ala', xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej winh yet' heb' schekab' winhaj Balac chi'.
Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Balac to wan sk'och winhaj Balaam chi', ix kot winh scha winh t'a yol b'e t'a jun chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Moab, t'a sti' ha ha' skuch Arnón, satxo smojonal ay.
Ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Yelk'olal wal ach wawtej, ¿tas yuj ijan maj a tak'kotlaj a b'a? Tekan ix a na' to manh ol in tzak'wan wak'an jantak tas tza nib'ej, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Manh ak' pensar, ayinxo eq'ui, palta max yal-laj walani tastak tzin nib'ej swala', anhej tastak schek Dios wala', anhej ol wala', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh yet' winhaj Balac chi' t'a chonhab' Quiriat-huzot.
Hata' ix schek winhaj Balac chi' miljokcham nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel yik schi winhaj Balaam chi' yet' pax heb' ichamtak winak schekab' winhaj Balac chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix ik'jib'at winhaj Balaam yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jolom witz skuch Bamot-baal, hata' syal yilanb'at janik'ok skampamento heb' israel heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Balaam t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Chek b'ochajk'e ukeok altar t'a tik, tza chekan ik'chajkot ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Balac tas ix yal winh chi', ix smol ak'an juntzanh silab' chi' heb' winh schawanhil, jun nok' kelem wakax yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel t'a junjun altar.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Balaam chi' t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a stz'ey juntzanh silab' tik, ol b'at wila'' tato sjawi Jehová yik slolon wet'ok, ol lajwok chi' ol walan t'ayach tas wal ol aj yalan t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh t'a jun niwan witz malaj ste'al.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ix in b'ok'e uke' altar, ix wak'ankank'e junjun nok' wakax yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel t'a yib'anh junjun, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' tas ol aj slolon winh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Meltzajanh b'aj ayek' winhaj Balac chi', tzalan tas ix wal tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix meltzaj winh, ix k'ochxi winh b'aj aykan linhan winhaj Balac yet' heb' yichamtak winakil Moab t'a stz'ey silab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Ayinek' t'a jun witz t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yol yik Aram, ayik ix in yawtankot winhaj Balac sreyal Moab. Kotanh, tza katab'an heb' israel. Alkan chukal lolonel t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi', xchib'at winh.
Palta, ¿tas wal tz'aj in katab'an anima to manhok Dios skatab'ani? ¿Tas wal tz'aj wak'an chukal tato manhok Jehová tz'ak'an chukal t'ay?

Te wach' wilanb'at jun chonhab' chi' ayik ayink'e t'a schon jun k'een k'een tik. Te wach' wilanb'at t'a jolom witz b'aj ayinek' tik. Ha jun chonhab' chi' ch'ok yajeli, max somb'atlaj sb'a t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Lajanxo sb'isul jun chonhab' chi' icha spokokal lum lum, ¿tokwal ay mach stzak'wan sb'isan nanhalok heb'? Komonok wal a in tzin cham t'a junk'olal icha juntzanh anima to wach' spensar chi', xchi winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Balac chi', ix och ijan winh yalanoch t'a sat winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --¿Tas aji? Ha yuj a katab'an heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin, yuj chi' ach wik'koti, palta haxo wach' lolonel tzalkan t'a yib'anh heb', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Yowalil a tas schek Jehová wala', a swala', xchi winh.
Palta ix ochnhej ijan winhaj Balac chi' yalan icha tik: --Konh wet' t'a junokxo lugar, b'aj janik'nhej syal kilan t'a stitak skampamento heb', a wal ta' ol a katab'ej heb' in k'ana', xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at winhaj Balaam yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jun jakan t'a sjolom lum witz Pisga. Hata' ix schek winh b'ochajxik'e uke' altar, ix yak'anxi nok' wakax yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' winh silab'il, junjun nok' t'a junjun altar.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Balaam chi' t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a stz'ey altar tik, yakb'an b'at in lolon yet' Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh, ix yalani tas ol yutok winh yalani. --Meltzajanh b'aj ayek' winhaj Balac chi', tzalan icha tz'aj walan tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix meltzaj winh b'aj aykan winhaj Balac yet' heb' ay yopisio aj Moab t'a stz'ey silab' chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Balac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik:

Ach Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor, scham wal ab'an tas ol wala': Ha Dios manh lajanok icha anima. Max yesejlaj, max ek'b'atlaj tas syala'. Tato ay junok tas syala', tz'elnhejk'ochi. Tato ay junok tas syaltej, syak'nhej.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin to swal wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalani, max yal-laj in k'exani.
Malaj junok yaelal syil Jehová to ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' yik heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob. Ha Jehová sDiosal heb', a ayoch sreyalok heb', aynhejpaxek' t'a skal heb'.
Ha Jehová ix ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha Jehová ayoch yipok sk'ol heb', icha nok' owal wakax a sch'aak ayoch yipok sk'ool.

Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob malaj yelk'och heb' naumel lolonel, malaj pax yelk'och heb' ajb'aal. Ha tiknaik yowalil tz'alchaj t'a chonhab' Israel icha tik: Tzijtum tas satub'takxonhej yoch ix sk'ulej Jehová t'ay, xchiokab'i.

Ha jun chonhab' tik syik'chaanh sb'a ichok nok' choj te ay smay. Ayik toxo ix och sat nok' t'a junok schib'ej, max och waan nok' spechani masanto syamchaji syuk'an schiq'uil nok', icha chi' yaj heb', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Tato max yal a katab'an jun chonhab' tik, mokab' alpaxkan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayach jun, to a tas ol schek Jehová wala', haton yowalil swala'? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Kotanh, ol ach wik'b'at t'a junokxo lugar, talaj hata' ol scha' sk'ol Dios a katab'an heb' israel chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jolom witz Peor, b'aj te chekel kilan masanil tzinan lu'um.

Ayik ayek' heb' winh ta', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Chek b'ochajk'e ukeokxo altar t'a tik in k'ana', tza chekan miljokcham ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, xchi winh.
Ix schekan winhaj Balac b'ojok ukexo altar chi' yik snhusjitz'a juntzanh nok' chi' t'a yib'anh.

Haxo yik ix nachajel yuj winhaj Balaam to scha sk'ol Jehová ayik syalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' israel, majxo b'atlaj winh sk'anb'ej yab' icha ix yutej t'a sb'ab'elal, anhej to ix b'at k'elan winh t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Haxo ix yilanb'at chonhab' Israel winh, t'a stzolal yaj junjun inhtilal heb' yet' skampamento, ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh,
yuj chi' ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Haton in lolonel a in Balaam in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beor, jichichi tz'aj wilani.
Swab' tas syal Dios. Icha wayichal tz'aj wilan Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin ek' jichan, palta jakan in sat, te wach' wilani.
Ex israel yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, te wach' yilji he mantiado. Te wach' kilanb'at he kampamento.

Icha wal yaj stzolal te' palma, icha wal chi' eyiljib'ati. Icha wal sb'at tzololok junok tas tz'awchaj t'a sti' junok ha ha', icha wal chi' eyajemi. Icha te' áloes awab'il yuj Jehová, ma icha wal yaj te' k'ute' t'a sti' ha ha'.

Ha b'aj ayek' chonhab' Israel chi', manhxo jantakok ha ha'. Wach'nhej yuk'an ha' heb' yet' yak'anoch yalil tas syawej heb'. Ha sreyal heb' te ay smay t'a yichanh winhaj rey Agag. Te niwan yaj smakb'en sreyal heb'.

Ha Jehová ix ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha Jehová ayoch yipok sk'ool heb', icha nok' owal wakax a sch'aak ayoch yipok sk'ool. Ha chonhab' Israel ol satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ol smak'poj sb'akil heb' yajk'ol heb' chi'. Ol k'axpajek' sjul-lab' heb' t'a sniwanil heb' yajk'ol chi'.

Lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' choj jichanek' swayi, malaj mach stek'b'ej sb'a stzuntzani. Ex israel, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a mach tz'alan wach' lolonel t'ayex, katab'ajokab' mach tzex katab'ani, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Balac chi', ix te kot yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix smuch'an jun sk'ab' winh ix schuk'anoch winh t'a yol junxo sk'ab' yuj yowal chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha yuj a katab'an heb' ajk'ol yajoch tik t'ayin ix ach wawtejkoti, haxo tiknaik yoxelalxo halan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh heb'.
Te wach' hama tzach meltzaj t'a a pat t'a elanhchamel. Toxo ix wala' to niwan tas ol wak' t'ayach, ol ach wik'anchaanh, palta max schalaj sk'ol Jehová to icha chi' tz'aji, xchi winhaj Balac chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Jichan ix aj walan t'a heb' a chekab':

Wach'chom b'ut'an a palakio yuj k'een oro, ma yuj k'een plata, tzak'an k'een t'ayin, palta max yal-laj in k'exan tas syal Jehová, max yal-laj wak'an wach'k'olal, ma in katab'an b'aj skot t'a in k'ol in k'ulani, yujto a tas schek Jehová wala', haton yowalil swala'.
Wach' ol in meltzaj t'a in chonhab'. Anhej, ayik mantzak in b'ati, swalkan t'ayach tas ol utaj a chonhab' tik yuj jun chonhab'il anima chi' t'a b'ak'uinh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Haton in lolonel a in Balaam in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beor, jichichi tz'aj wilani.

Swab' tas syal Dios Ek'to t'a yib'anh Smasanil, wojtak tas yaj spensar, swilanpax icha wayichal. Ha Dios Syal yuj Smasanil chi' tz'ak'an wojtakejeli. Tzin ek' jichan, palta jakan in sat, te wach'nhej wilani.

Ay jun mach najatto ay, palta syal wilanb'ati. Ay jun rey ol cheklajk'e t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, tzikiki yilji icha k'een k'anal. Ha jun rey chi' ol yak' yajalil t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Israel. A' ol satanel chonhab' Moab, a pax ol satanel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Set.
Ol kan chonhab' Edom t'a yalanh yuj, ol ochkan lum Seir chi' yikok. Ha chonhab' Israel ol yik' yip.
Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob ol elta jun mach ol och Yajalil. A' ol satanel jantakto mach ol kan t'a yol jun chonhab' chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yilanb'at chonhab' Amalec winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha chonhab' Amalec yelxo ay smay t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', palta ol satel t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.
Ix b'at k'elan winh t'a schonhab' heb' kenita, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ex kenita, wach'chom te ay smay he chonhab' yik skolan sb'a, wach'chom t'a schontak k'een niwak tenam tzeyak'k'e he pat,
palta ol satkanel he chonhab' chi', a jantak exto ol ex kanok, ol ex yik'kanb'at heb' winh asirio schekab'ok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Ay, ¿tokwal ayto mach ol kanok ayik ol sk'ulan juntzanh tik Dios?
Ay te' barko ol kot t'a Chipre, ol ja t'a sti' ha' mar yik tzul yixtan chonhab' Asiria yet' chonhab' Heber, palta ol satjokpaxel heb' aj Chipre chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh tik winh, ix meltzaj winh t'a schonhab', haxo winhaj Balac ix meltzajxikan winh b'aj kajan.
Ayik ayek' heb' israel t'a Sitim, tzijtum heb' winh winak ix mulan yet' heb' ix moabita.

Ix montajb'at heb' winh yuj heb' ix b'aj tz'och sq'uinhal sdiosal. Ix schi'an nok' chib'ej heb' winh israel chi', nok' silab'ej heb' ix t'a sdiosal chi'. Ix ochpax heb' winh ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' ix chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'ajb'at heb' winh yoch ejmelal t'a jun yechel skuch Baal, sdiosal chonhab' Peor, yuj chi' ix te kot yowal Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel chi',

ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik: --Molb'ej masanil heb' ix kuchb'anb'at heb' anima tik t'a juntzanh chukal chi', wal t'a wichanh yet' t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab' tza t'unhb'ejk'e heb'. Icha chi' ol aj sikb'iem yowal in k'ol t'a chonhab' Israel tik, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yajalil chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Junjun ex t'a eyinhtilal tze milcham heb' winh ix b'at och ejmelal t'a Baal, xchi winh.

Junanto rato chi' ix ek'b'at jun winh israel yet' jun ix aj Madián wan yik'anb'at ix winh t'a smantiado. Ix ek'b'at winh t'a slak'anil skajnub' Jehová t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés yet' heb' anima molaneq'ui yik tz'ok' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar, yixchikinkan winhaj Aarón winh b'ab'el sat sakerdote, ix k'e waan winh t'a skal heb' anima ayek' molan chi'. Ix yik'ankot slanza winh, ix b'at tzak'an winh yuj jun winh israel yet' ix aj Madián chi',

masanto ix k'och winh t'a yol smantiado winh. Ix stekan k'axpaj k'een lanza chi' winh t'a yol sk'ol winh israel yet' ix aj Madián chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch waan scham anima yuj jun ilya ix yak'kot Jehová t'a skal heb' israel chi'.
Ay 24 mil anima ix cham yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

--Ha winhaj Finees ix ak'an sikb'ok yowal in k'ool, ix lajwi wowal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel tik, yapax ix yab' winh wet'ok yujto ix sna winh to a innhej niwan welk'ochi, yuj chi', tato manh ichokta ix sk'ulej winh, masanil am heb' anima tik ix sateli.

Yuj chi' al t'a winh icha tik: Yujto ya ix ab' wet'ok, yujto ix a na' to a innhej niwan welk'ochi, yuj chi' ix ak' sikb'okem yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb' anima tik, yuj chi' ol in b'o in trato het'ok yet' masanil heb' inhtilal, ol ochkan heb' sakerdoteal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha jun winh ix cham yet' ix aj Madián yuj winhaj Finees chi', Zimri sb'i winh, yuninal winhaj Salu, yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal Simeón.
Haxo pax ix ix, ix cham chi', Kozbi sb'i ix, yisil ix winhaj Zur, yajal yaj t'a jun makan anima t'a Madián.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
--Hak'ek owal yet' heb' aj Madián, tze satanel heb',

yujto ix ex och t'a yol sk'ab' yaelal yuj heb' ayik ix ex yik'anb'at heb' eyoch ejmelal t'a sdiosal t'a Peor. Naekkoti tas ix ex yutej ix Kozbi, haton ix yisil jun winh yajal yaj t'a heb', yuj chi' ix tekjicham ix t'a k'een lanza, ayik ix wak'anb'at ilya t'a he kal, yujto tzijtum mach ix och ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwiek' jun ilya to scham anima chi' yuj, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Eleazar sat sakerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón:
--Ik'ekchaanh sb'isul heb' israel t'a junjun makanhil yaj heb', tz'el yich t'a heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal stiempo wal sb'at t'a owal, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ix smolb'an masanil heb' winak winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar t'a yak'likal Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán, t'a yichanhkot Jericó,
yik stz'ib'chaj masanil heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Haton masanil heb' ix elta t'a Egipto:

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel, ay 43 mil 730 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Enoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Ezrón yet' winhaj Carmi.
Ha winhaj Falú chi' ay yuninal winhaj Eliab,

haxo pax winhaj Eliab ay yuninal winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram, yichamtak winakil chonhab' yaj heb'. Haton heb' junnhej ajnak slajti' yet' winhaj Coré. Meltzajnakoch heb' ajk'olal t'a Jehová, t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón.

Palta paxnak lewnaj lum lum, emnakkan heb' chawanh chi' t'a yol lum yet' winhaj Coré. Masanil heb' ochnak tzak'an yuj winhaj Coré chi' chamnak heb', haton heb' 250 chamnak yuj jun k'ak'. Ha juntzanh heb' chi' ochnak ch'oxnab'ilok t'a heb' israel smasanil.
Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coré chi', maj satel-laj heb'.

Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Simeón, ay 22 mil 200 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Saúl.

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Gad, ay 40 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Zefón, winhaj Hagui, winhaj Suni, winhaj Ozni, winhaj Eri, winhaj Arod yet' winhaj Areli.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 76 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Sela, winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zera. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Fares sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul. Ha pax heb' yuninal winhaj Judá ix cham t'a lum Canaán haton winhaj Er yet' winhaj Onán.

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Isacar, ay 64 mil 300 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Jasub yet' winhaj Simrón.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Zabulón, ay 60 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Sered, winhaj Elón yet' winhaj Jahleel.

Haxo pax t'a yinhtilalkan José, chab' inhtilal yaj heb', haton yik Manasés yet' yik Efraín. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés chi', ay 52 mil 700 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha heb' sb'inajkan t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal winh: Haton winhaj Maquir yet' winhaj Galaad yuninal winhaj Maquir chi' yet' pax heb' yuninal winhaj Galaad chi', haton winhaj Jezer, winhaj Helec, winhaj Asriel, winhaj Siquem, winhaj Semida yet' winhaj Hefer. (Ha winhaj Zelofehad yuninal winhaj Hefer, malaj yuninal winh, anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay: Haton ix Maala, ix Noa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Tirsa.)

Haxo heb' yinhtilalkan Efraín, ay 32 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Sutela, winhaj Bequer yet' winhaj Tahán. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Sutela chi' sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal, haton winhaj Erán.

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Benjamín, ay 45 mil 600 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Bela, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Ahiram, winhaj Sufam yet' winhaj Hufam. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bela sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal, haton winhaj Ard yet' winhaj Naamán.
Ha pax heb' yinhtilalkan Dan, ay 64 mil 400 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha winh sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal, haton winhaj Suham.

Haxo pax yinhtilalkan Aser, ay 53 mil 400 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúi yet' winhaj Bería. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bería chi' sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Haton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malkiel. (Ha winhaj Aser chi' ay jun ix yisil winh skuchan Sera).

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Neftalí, ay 45 mil 400 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, haton tik: Winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Silem.
Yuj chi' a sb'isul masanil heb' winak yik chonhab' Israel, ay 601 mil 730 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan icha tik:
Pukchajokab'ek' lum lum t'a skal junjun inhtilal hato syala' jantak sb'isul junjun ix k'e waan.
T'a suerteal tz'aj spukchajek' lu'um t'a heb'. Niwan lum tzak' t'a heb' niwan sb'isul, kennhej lum tzak' t'a heb' kennhej sb'isul, xchi t'a winh.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Winhaj Gersón, winhaj Koat yet' winhaj Merari.

Ha heb' yixchikin winhaj Leví chi' sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Winhaj Libni, winhaj Hebrón, winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Coré, haton heb' winh tik yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví. Ha winhaj Koat chi', haton winh smam winhaj Amram.

Ha winhaj Amram chi' ix yik' sb'a yet' jun ix yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví chi', haton ix skuchan Jokabed. Ayik ayek' winhaj Leví chi' t'a Egipto ix alji ix. Ha winhaj Amram yet' ix Jokabed chi', haton heb' smam snun winhaj Aarón, winhaj Moisés yet' ix María.
Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón, haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', ix cham heb' winh yujto ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh manh smojok icha ofrenda t'a yichanh Jehová.

Masanil heb' winak t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví, haton heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 23 mil heb'. Ha heb' tik manh ayokoch heb' sb'isulok juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal, yujto a heb' lewita tik malaj smakb'en heb' ol scha'a, ayik ol k'och heb' t'a lum Canaán.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och sb'isul heb' israel ix ik'jichaanh yuj winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar t'a ak'lik t'a yol yik Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanhkot Jericó.
Masanil heb' chi', malaj junok heb' ix b'isji yuj winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ayik ix yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' winh t'a sb'ab'elal t'a tzinan lu'um Sinaí,
yujto ix yal Jehová to ol cham heb' t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Manhxa junok heb' chi' ix kani, haxonhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun ix kani.

Ay jun winh t'a yinhtilal Manasés skuch Zelofehad. Haton stzolal smam yicham winh tik: Winhaj Hefer, winhaj Galaad, winhaj Maquir, winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj José. Ha winhaj Zelofehad chi' ay owanh heb' ix yisil winh: Haton ix Maala, ix Noa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Tirsa.

Ha owanh heb' ix snulej sb'a tik, ix b'at heb' ix b'aj ay kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ix yalan heb' ix t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' icha tik:

Ha winh ko mam a onh tik, ix cham winh t'a tzinan lu'um, palta manh lokanoklaj winh yet' heb' yik winhaj Coré ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová. Ha winh ko mam chi' yujnhej smul winh t'a yol yiko' ix cham winh, malaj junok yuninal winh ix kani.

Palta manh smojok satkanel sb'i winh t'a slistail kinhtilal, yujnhej to malaj junok yuninal winh ix kani. Yuj chi' ol eyak' junok makan ko lu'um t'a skal yik heb' winh yuk'tak winh ko mam chi', xchi heb' ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés masanil tas ix yal heb' ix ix chi' t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik:
Ha heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad chi', yel syal heb' ix. Ol ak' junok makan sluum heb' ix t'a skal yik heb' winh yuk'tak winh smam heb' ix chi', haxo heb' ix ol ik'ankan smakb'en winh smam chi'.
Alpax t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach schami, malaj junok yuninal winak skani, a smakb'en syal skan t'a heb' ix yisil.
Palta tato malaj junok yisil chi', ha t'a junok yuk'tak skan smakb'en chi'.
Tato malaj junok yuk'tak chi' jun, ha t'a heb' yuk'tak smam skan smakb'en chi'.
Tato a smam chi' malaj pax yuk'tak, ha t'a junok sk'ab' yok, hata' skan smakb'en chi'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a skal chonhab' Israel, icha tz'aj walan tik t'ayach, xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Q'ueanh t'a jolom witz Abarim, tzilankanb'at lum ol wak' t'a heb' etchonhab' tik.
Anhej slajwi ilanb'at lu'um, ol ach chamok, icha wal ix aj scham winh uk'tak aj Aarón,

yujto maj in he k'anab'ajej, maj in eyik'chaanh t'a tzinan lum yik Zin, ayik ix kot yowal heb' anima t'ayin. Maj he k'anab'ajej he ch'oxanel t'a yichanh heb' eyetchonhab' to Ha inxonhej Ochi ayik ix k'e yaw heb' sk'anan ha ha' yuk'ej, xchi t'a winh. (Ix uji jun chi' b'aj ay ha ha' skuch Meriba t'a Cades, t'a lum tzinan lu'um yik Zin.)
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová chi' icha tik:
--Mamin Jehová, a ach tzak' sk'inal masanil anima. Ha tiknaik ak'och a sat t'a junok mach tz'och yajalilok a chonhab',
yik skuchb'ejb'at heb' yik sb'atnhej heb', yik max satek' heb' icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Te ay wal och Wespíritu t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, yuj chi' ak'b'at a k'ab' t'a sjolom winh.
T'a wal yichanh winhaj sat sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, tzak'ankanoch yopisio winh.
Ak'kanoch jab'ok opisio chi' t'a yib'anh winh, yik wach' ol sk'anab'ajej masanil heb' anima tas ol yal winh.

Ha t'a winhaj Eleazar ol yal winh, haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' ol k'anb'an t'ayin yuj winh. Ha inxo Jehová in tik ol wal yet' k'een Urim tas ol yutej sb'a winh. Haxo winh ol halan t'a heb' chonhab' chi' tas ol aj heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at winhaj Josué chi' yuj winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sjolom winhaj Josué chi', ix yak'ankan yopisio winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab' chi': Ha t'a stiempoal chekel yajkani, sk'anab'ajej heb' yak'an juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, te suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' yuj juntzanh ofrenda yowalil snhustz'a heb' yuj yik'jichaanh Jehová. Junjun k'u snhusjitz'a chatakwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Jun nok' snhusjitz'a t'a q'uinhib'alil, haxo junxo nok' t'a yemk'ualil. Yowalil tz'ak'ji chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach', skalaj yet' junok litro akeite yik sat te' oliwo ofrendail yet' junjun nok'. Tz'ak'jipax junjun litro wino yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi', sekchajem b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová yuj yik'jichaanh. Ha t'a lum witzal Sinaí ix schek Jehová ak'jok juntzanh silab' tik t'a junjun k'u, haton ofrenda suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.

Ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, yowalil syak' chawanhokxo nok' kelemtak kalnel heb', haton nok' jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail yet' wajxake' libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite t'a ofrendail t'a ixim trigo. Tz'ak'jipax wino yet'ok, ichataxon tz'aj yak'ji.
Masanil juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, palta ch'ok yel t'a yichanh silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik junjun uj tzeyak' chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax silab'il yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil nok' tik, mokab'a jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' junjun nok' wakax chi' tzeyak' lajchaweok libra ixim harina te wach', tze kalan yet' akeite. Haxo yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' tzeyak' wajxakeok libra ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite.
Haxo yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite tzeyak'a'. Haton jun ofrenda snhusjitz'a chi', suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.

Haxo wino tz'ak'jitaxon t'a ofrendail, chab' litro tz'ak'ji yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', nanhal schab'il litro t'a jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', junjun litro t'a junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'. Haton juntzanh ofrenda chi' yowalil tz'ak'ji t'a junjun uj t'a yol ab'il.
Ha yet' silab' snhusjitz'a chi', tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa t'a Jehová silab'il yuj mul yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.
T'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, hata' tz'och q'uinh yik tze naankoti ayik eyelnak libre yuj Jehová.
Haxo t'a 15 yoch uj chi', hata' tz'och uke' k'ual q'uinh, haton ta' swaji ixim pan malaj yich.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u t'a uke' k'ual chi' tz'och jun niwan molanil yuj eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.
Chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax tz'ak'ji silab'il, jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil nok' chi', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji juntzanhxo ofrenda tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok, ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite, tz'ak'ji icha tik: Lajchawe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj mul yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji yet' jun silab' snhusjitz'a t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junjun k'u.

Icha chi' tz'aj t'a junjun k'u t'a uke' k'ual q'uinh chi'. Snhusjitz'a juntzanh ofrenda chi', suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová. Palta ch'ok pax yaj silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.
Haxo t'a yukil k'ual, tz'ochpax junxo niwan molanil yuj eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.

Ayik toxo ix ek'b'at uke' semana yek' q'uinh yik tze naankot eyelnak libre yuj Jehová, tzeyak'an eyofrenda yuj sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en tze molo'. Tze molb'ej he b'a he masanil yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová, malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.
Tzeyak'pax junok silab' te wach' t'a Jehová suk'uq'ui sjab' syab'i: Chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal,
yet' ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'jitaxoni, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj he mul.
Ha yet' juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'jinhej ofrenda t'a ixim harina yet' wino. Tzeyak'anpax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u. Masanil nok' tz'ak'ji chi', yowalil malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik yukil uj, tze molb'ej he b'a yik tzex och ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'ual chi' malaj junok mach smunlaji. Ha jun k'ual chi', sk'ual yik spuji k'een trompeta.

Tze nhusantz'a juntzanh silab' suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová: Jun nok' kelem wakax, junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Tzeyak'anpax ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' jun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh.

Tz'ak'jipax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun uj yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxoni, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Ha juntzanh chi' haton ofrenda snhusji, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.
T'a slajunhil k'ual yoch yukil uj chi', tze molb'anpax he b'a yuj eyoch ejmelal, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.

Tze nhusantz'a juntzanh silab' suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová, jun nok' kelem wakax, jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Tzeyak'anpax ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite yet'ok, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' jun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul. Tzeyak'anpax silab' tz'ak'ji t'a sk'ual yak'ji tup mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u, ixim harina yet' pax wino.
Hanheja' t'a 15 k'ual yoch yukil uj tze molb'ej he b'a eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej. Uke' k'ual tzeyak'och q'uinh yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová.

Ha t'a junjun k'ual q'uinh chi' tze nhusantz'a juntzanh nok' nok' t'a silab'il, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová: Chawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 14-ok nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'. Yet' pax ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'ji ofrendail: Wajxake' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'. Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok t'a ofrendail. Ha yet' juntzanh nok' nok' chi', tzeyak'pax 13-ok nok' kelemtak wakax t'a b'ab'el k'u, 12-ok nok' t'a schab'il k'ual, 11-ok nok' t'a yoxil k'ual, 10-ok nok' t'a schanhil k'ual, b'alunhwanhok nok' t'a yoil k'ual, wajxakwanhok nok' t'a swakil k'ual, ukwanhok nok' t'a yukil k'ual. Ha yet' junjun nok' kelemtak wakax chi' tz'ak'ji lajchaweok libra ixim harina wach', kalab'il yet' akeite. Stz'a juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.
Haxo t'a swajxakil k'ual, tze molb'anoch he b'a eyoch ejmelal. Malaj munlajel tze k'ulej t'a jun k'ual chi'.

Tze nhusantz'a junok nok' kelem wakax silab'il te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' spaltail nok'.
Hanhejtona' tzeyak'anpax ixim harina ofrendail yet' wino yet' nok' wakax chi', nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' yet' pax nok' kelemtak kalnel chi' icha yalan ley.
Tzeyak'an junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok t'a ofrendail.

Haton juntzanh silab' tik yowalil tzeyak' t'a Jehová t'a juntzanh q'uinh to chekel yaj sk'ual. Ha yet' juntzanh tik syal eyak'anpax ofrenda to ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma junok ofrenda tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani. Syal eyak'an silab' to stz'ai, ixim harina, ma wino t'a ofrendail, ma silab' yik junk'olal.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' israel masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal Israel icha tik:
Ix yal Jehová tato ay junok winh winak syak' sti' yak'an junok tas t'a Jehová, mato syak' sti' t'a junok tas ol sk'ulej, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan tas ix yal chi'. Max yal sk'exan tas ix yal chi'.
Tato a junok ix kob'es aytoek' yet' smam, syak' sti' yak'an junok tas t'a Jehová, mato syak' sti' t'a junok tas manh ol sk'ulej,
tato malaj tas syal winh smam ix chi' ayik syab'an winh to ay sti' ix ix yak'a', yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix sk'ulan b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.

Palta tato ha' winh smam ix chi' tz'ak'an yowalil ayik syab'an winh to ay sti' ix ix yak'a', tato icha chi', manhxo yowalilok sk'ulej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'. Maxtzak ak'jilaj pural ix yuj Jehová b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Tato ay junok ix ix syak' sti' t'a Jehová wach'chom ix cham wal snaani, ma jun elanhchamel ix yal ix to sk'ulej junok tasi, slajwi yak'an sti' ix chi' tz'och yetb'eyum ix,
tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', malajnhej tas syal winh yuj, yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Palta tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi' jun, malaj snib'ej winh, manh yowalilok sk'anab'ajej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', max ak'jipaxlaj pural ix yuj Jehová sk'anab'ajani.
Tato a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum, ma heb' ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum syak' sti' t'a junok tas t'a Jehová, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' ix.
Tato a junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum syak' sti' sk'ulan junok tasi, mato syak' sti' t'a junok tas manh ol sk'ulej,
tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi', malajnhej tas syal winh, a ix chi' yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Palta tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi', tato malaj snib'ej winh, manh yowalilok sk'anab'ajej ix sk'ulan b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'. Max ak'jilaj pural ix yuj Jehová sk'ulani.
Ha winh etb'eyumab'il chi', syal yalan winh tato syal sk'anab'ajan ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi' mato maay.
Tato ayxo jun chab'ok k'ual yab'an jun chi' winh, malajnhejpax tas syal winh, yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix sk'ulan b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Tato ayik toxo ix ek' tiempo, ichato chi' syalan winh to max sk'anab'ajej ix, haxo t'a yib'anh winh skan smul ix b'aj maj sk'anab'ajej sti' ix syak' chi', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Haton juntzanh ley ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yuj tas wal tz'aj winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum, ma heb' winh mamab'il yet' heb' ix yisil kob'esto aytoek' yet'ok, tato syak' sti' heb' ix t'a Jehová.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to spak sb'a heb' t'a heb' aj Madián, slajwi chi' ol ach chamok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' icha tik: --Hak'ek lista he b'a jaywanhok ex t'a owal, tze satanel heb' aj Madián yuj spaktzitaj schukal heb' t'a Jehová.
Junjun inhtilal, mil winak syak'b'at t'a owal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix sik'jiel mil heb' soldado t'a junjun inhtilal. Ay 12 mil heb' t'a smasanil, yet'nakxok'e syamk'ab' junjun heb' yik owal.

Ichaton chi' ix aj schekjib'at heb' t'a owal yuj winhaj Moisés. Ix b'atpax winhaj Finees, yuninal winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' heb'. Ha winh et'jinak juntzanh yamk'ab' to yik Dios yaji yet' k'een trompeta spuji yik tz'och heb' yak' owal.
Ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' madianita icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix smilancham masanil heb' winh winak heb'.
T'a skal heb' ix cham chi', ix cham winhaj Evi, winhaj Requem, winhaj Zur, winhaj Hur yet' winhaj Reba, haton owanh heb' winh yajal t'a Madián. Ix champax winhaj Balaam yuninal winhaj Beor.
Ix ik'jikot masanil heb' ix ix aj Madián preso yuj heb' israel yet' masanil heb' skotak unin heb', nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Ix nhusjitz'a schonhab' heb' yet' skampamento heb' yuj heb' israel chi'.
Masanil ix yik'ek' heb' soldadoal israel chi', heb' anima yet' masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb',

ix yik'kot heb', ix yak'an heb' t'a winhaj Moisés, t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' pax t'a heb' yetchonhab' heb'. Ha t'a yak'likal Moab t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó ayek' skampamento heb'.
Ix elta winhaj Moisés, winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' scha heb' t'a spatikel kampamento chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Moisés ix kot yowal winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a junjun mil yet' t'a junjun kien heb' soldado ix meltzaj t'a owal chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj maj he milcham juntzanh heb' ix ix tik?

Ha yuj tas ix yal winhaj Balaam, a wal heb' ix ix tik ix ik'anb'at heb' ketisraelal t'a ajmulal. Ix och smul heb' t'a Jehová yuj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios Baal t'a Peor. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix cham yuj jun ilya.
Ha tiknaik milekcham masanil heb' winak unin yet' masanil heb' ix ix to ayxo winak ix ek' t'a spatik.
Haxo heb' ix kob'estak mantalaj winak tzek' t'a spatik, manh he milcham heb' ix, kanokab' heb' ix heyet'ok.

E masanil mach ex ix he milcham anima, ma ix eyam junok chamnak, kananhek ukeok k'ual t'a spatikel kampamento. Ha ex tik yet' heb' preso yaj eyuuj, yowalil tze b'ikel he b'a t'a schab'jial yet' t'a swak'jial.
Tze juk'anel he pichul yet' masanil tastak b'ob'il t'a nok' tz'uum, ma t'a xil nok' chiwa yet' t'a te te', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj sakerdote Eleazar t'a masanil heb' ix xit'ek' t'a owal chi' icha tik: --Haton jun ley ix yak' Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés tik:

Ha masanil tastak to max tz'a yuj k'ak', icha k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronke, k'een hierro, k'een estaño, ma k'een plomo, yowalil tzek' t'a kal k'ak', slajwi chi' tze b'ikanel t'a ha ha' sakb'itan tastak tz'och wikok. Ha pax tastak to stz'ab'at jun, anhej yet' ha ha' chi' tze sakb'itej.
Haxo t'a swak'jial, yowalil tze juk'el he pichul, icha chi' tz'aj he sakb'ikaneli. Ichato chi' syal eyoch t'a yol kampamento, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, xchi winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ha winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makanhil heb' chonhab', ol och heb' het'ok yik tze b'is heb' anima yet' masanil nok' nok' ix yik'kot heb' t'a chonhab' Madián.
Cha makan tzeyutej. Tze pojanek' junok makan t'a skal heb' soldado ix xit'ek' t'a owal chi', haxo junxo makan, spojchajek' t'a skal heb' anima.
Ha t'a junjun makan syik' heb' soldado chi', junjun wik tzeyik'el t'a junjun 500 anima, t'a junjun 500 nok' nok', wach'chom nok' wakax, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel ma nok' chiwa.
Ha t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar tzak' juntzanh chi' icha ofrenda t'ayin.

Ha t'a nanhalxo yik heb' anima chi', junjun tzeyik'el t'a junjun 50 heb' anima yet' t'a junjun 50 nok' nok', wach'chom nok' wakax, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa ma yet' yalnhej tas molb'etzal nok'. Tzeyak' juntzanh nok' nok' chi' t'a heb' lewita haton heb' yilumal in kajnub', xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.
Haton slistail masanil tastak ix yik'kot heb' soldado tik, ch'ok pax tastak ix yik' junjun heb': 675 mil nok' kalnel, 72 mil nok' wakax, 61 mil nok' b'uru yet' 32 mil heb' ix kob'estak.
Yuj chi' nanhal wal juntzanh chi' ix yik' heb' soldado. 337 mil 500 nok' kalnel ix yik' heb'.
Ha t'a juntzanh nok' chi', 675 nok' ix yak' heb' t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a 36 mil nok' wakax yik heb' soldado, ix ak'ji 72 nok' t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a 30 mil 500 nok' b'uru yik heb' soldado, ix ak'ji 61 nok' t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a heb' ix 16 mil kob'estak yik heb' soldado, ix ak'ji 32 heb' ix t'a Jehová.
Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak' winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar, haton tas to yiktaxon Jehová yaji, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
Icha wal sb'isul ix yik' heb' soldado chi', icha chi' ix yak' winhaj Moisés t'a heb' anima chi': 337 mil 500 nok' kalnel, 36 mil nok' wakax, 30 mil 500 nok' b'uru yet' 16 mil heb' ix kob'estak.

Ha t'a nanhalxo chi', junjun ix yik'el winhaj Moisés t'a junjun 50. Lajannhej ix yutejpax heb' anima winh yet' nok' nok'. Ix yak'an winh t'a heb' lewita smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.
Haxo heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun mil yet' t'a junjun kien heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' yal t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik ix ko b'is heb' soldado ayoch t'a yol ko k'ab', malaj junok heb' ix satb'ati, tz'akannhej heb'.

Yet'nak masanil k'een oro ix ilchaj yuj heb', k'een brazaletes, pulseras, kolk'ab', uchikin yet' juntzanhxo k'een k'een wach' yilji. Ha juntzanh tik skak' t'a Jehová, yujto ix kolwaj ket'ok, yuj chi' ix onh meltzaj ko masanil, xchi heb'.
Ix schaan masanil k'een oro chi' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar t'a heb', haton masanil k'een oro ayoch yelwanub'ok sniwanil heb'.
Masanil k'een oro ix yak' heb' yajal chi', oxe' kintal yet' 68 libra yalil k'een.
Junjun soldado aynhej jab'jab'ok tastak ix yik'a', haton tastak ix yik' heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Haxo winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' ix chaan k'een oro ix yik'kot heb' yajal soldado chi'. Ix yik'anb'at k'een heb' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, yik wach' snachajkot heb' israel yuj Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' heb' yik Gad manhxo jantakok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ayik ix yilan heb' to a lum skuchan Jazer yet' Galaad, te wach' lum yik smolji nok' nok',
ix b'at heb' yil winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' pax heb' yajalil chonhab'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a heb':

--Ilek wal lum makb'il yuj juntzanh chonhab' tik: Haton Atarot, Dibón, Jazer, Nimra, Hesbón, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo yet' Beón, te wach' swa masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' t'a juntzanh lum lum tik. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix kik'kanek' lu'um yik tz'ochkan lum kikok a onh israel onh tik. Eyojtakpaxi to ay juntzanh nok' nok' tik molb'il kuuj.
Yuj chi' tato wach' tze na'a, aq'ek juntzanh lum tik t'ayonh, yik max onh ek'kan t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --¿Tom he gana tzex kan t'a tik yakb'an sb'at heb' ketchonhab' t'a owal?
¿Tas yuj tzeyak' chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' ketchonhab' yik max ek' heb' t'a jun lum yalnak Jehová to ol yak' t'a heb'?
Icha wal tik yutej sb'a heb' ko mam kicham ayik in chekanb'at heb' yil lu'um ayik ayonhek' t'a Cades-barnea.
k'och heb' yil jun lu'um chi' masanto t'a sch'olanil ha' Escol. Slajwi chi' yak'an chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' ketisraelal heb' yik max och heb' t'a lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayonh.
Yuj wal chi' kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a jun k'u chi', yuj chi' yak' sti' to

a heb' anima 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, manh ol yil-laj lum heb', lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, yujto manh smasanilok sk'ol heb' och tzak'an yuj tas yala'.
Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yinhtilal winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, ol och t'a lu'um, haton heb' winh k'anab'ajan t'a smasanil sk'ool tas yal Jehová chi'.
Kot yowal Jehová chi' t'ayonh, yuj chi' 40 ab'il onh ek' t'a tzinan lum yuj, masanto ix satel masanil heb' maj k'anab'ajani, manhxo junok heb' ix kani.
Ha exxo tik, ex yinhtilal anima pit, he gana tze b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' ko mam kicham chi' yik tze tzuntzanxikot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh.
Tato malaj he gana tzex och tzak'an yuj Jehová chi', ol ex yaktejkan t'a jun tzinan lu'um tik yet' masanil jun chonhab' tik. Eyuuj wal ol onh satelok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
